cases.title: 泳池运镜
cases.prompt: Have the woman bob up and down in the pool. Crane the camera up to an aerial shot and move down into a high angle close up on the woman.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A surreal suburban drama cinematic live-action short video carries a dreamlike, languid atmosphere with a pervading sense of stillness.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Young adult woman with fair skin, dark brown wet hair spread loosely around her head, closed eyes and slightly parted lips, wearing a sheer long-sleeved cream dress that clings wet to her body and reaches below the knees; she floats supine in the water with arms extended outward and legs held straight together, feet pointed.
<Subject2>: Structured taupe leather handbag with two short rolled top handles, gold-tone hardware, a small rectangular metal logo plate on the front, and side gussets, resting upright on the pool coping.
<Subject3>: Pair of nude patent-leather block-heel pumps with rounded toes and low heels, set side by side on the grass with toes pointing toward the pool.
<Scene1>: Suburban backyard swimming pool on a sunny afternoon; rectangular in-ground pool with bright turquoise water, a blue mosaic tile line along the interior wall, light beige concrete coping with small rectangular drain covers, and a polished stainless-steel entry ladder with two curved handrails set into the near edge. Surrounding the pool is a closely mown green lawn, a single beige fabric-and-metal patio lounge chair on the grass at frame left, dense dark green hedges along the brick house, a weathered dark brown wooden privacy fence across the back, leafy green trees beyond the fence, a teal plastic chair and a white bucket near the fence line, and neighboring single-story houses with brown shingled roofs visible above the fence. Warm golden afternoon sunlight falls across the yard, casting sharp shadows and dappled reflections across the rippling water.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In a sun-dappled suburban backyard pool <Scene1>, the woman <Subject1> floats supine in her wet cream dress beside the taupe handbag <Subject2> and nude pumps <Subject3>, bobbing gently in the water while the camera cranes up to an aerial view and then descends into a high-angle close-up of her face.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a soft, dreamy ambient score with slow piano and low sustained strings begins]. A locked-off eye-level wide shot frames <Scene1> with <Subject1> floating supine in the turquoise pool near the stainless-steel ladder, her arms spread wide at shoulder height with palms open, legs extended straight and feet pointed just below the surface, dark hair fanning out around her head and her cream dress clinging wet and translucent across her torso and thighs; at the lower right of the concrete coping, <Subject2> stands upright beside <Subject3>, which rests on the grass with toes toward the water, while the beige lounge chair sits empty on the lawn at frame left and the brick house, hedges, dark fence and neighboring roofs fill the sunlit background. <Subject1> begins a slow rhythmic bob: her shoulders and chest rise a few inches as her back arches slightly and her chin tilts higher, then sink back until the waterline laps at her jaw and collarbone, her open hands drifting a little outward and back with each rise while small concentric ripples spread from beneath her and sunlight shimmers across the pool tiles <soft water lapping and gentle pool ripples>. The camera then begins a smooth crane upward, lifting from the eye-level wide view while keeping <Subject1> centered; the coping, ladder, handbag, pumps, lounge chair and fence shrink beneath the rising viewpoint as the rectangular shape of the pool and the surrounding lawn open into a top-down aerial composition, with <Subject1>'s outstretched body forming a pale cross shape against the bright turquoise water and her bobbing motion continuing at the same unhurried pace.

At 4.2 seconds, [the soft dreamy ambient score continues]. The high aerial view holds for a moment, showing the full pool rectangle, the ladder at the near edge, <Subject2> and <Subject3> as small taupe and pale shapes on the lower-right coping, and the dark fence and green hedges framing the yard, while <Subject1> completes another slow rise and fall at the center of the water, ripples widening outward from her body. The camera then begins a straight downward descent directly over <Subject1>, the framing tightening steadily from the full aerial view into a high-angle shot as the coping, lawn and background objects slide out toward the edges and then out of frame; the water's dappled caustic light patterns slide across her wet dress, her outstretched arms and her face as she continues bobbing, her head tilting back a little more on each rise and her dark hair spreading in a darker wet halo around her shoulders. Finally the descent settles into a high-angle close-up that holds directly above <Subject1>, framing her closed eyes, parted lips, wet hair and the upper curve of her shoulders and chest just breaking the surface, with the turquoise water and moving sunlight filling the background around her while her slow bobbing continues and the water laps softly at her cheeks.

# Additional Information
## Duration
8.0 seconds
## Aspect Ratio
30:17

cases.title: 草地小狗
cases.prompt: The camera circles 360° around the dog while wind ripples through the grass and clouds cast moving shadows across the hillside.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A pastoral nature cinematic live-action short video carries a warm, peaceful, and gently uplifting atmosphere with a pervading sense of calm.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Adult Australian Shepherd dog with a thick medium-length tri-color merle coat; broad white blaze running down the center of the face, rich tan cheeks and brow patches, blue-merle grey-black fur across the folded ears and top of the head, a full fluffy white chest and neck ruff, tan front legs with white sock markings on the paws, and a black nose; warm amber-brown eyes, an open panting mouth showing a pink tongue and white teeth, and a soft alert expression.
<Scene1>: Open outdoor grassy hillside under an overcast sky; lush long green grass with visible blades bending in the foreground, a gentle upward slope rising toward dense dark green leafy bushes and trees along the horizon, a pale grey-white cloudy sky overhead, and soft diffused overcast daylight that shifts as moving cloud shadows drift across the turf.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a breezy grassy hillside <Scene1>, a tri-color Australian Shepherd <Subject1> sits panting in the long grass while the camera completes a full 360-degree orbit around it, wind ripples through the surrounding blades, and cloud shadows sweep across the slope.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a soft, warm pastoral acoustic guitar score begins]. A locked-off eye-level medium shot frames <Subject1> seated upright at the center of <Scene1>, facing directly toward the camera with front legs planted in the long green grass, chest puffed, ears relaxed at the sides of the head, mouth open in a happy pant with the pink tongue hanging down; the lush grass fills the foreground with individual blades catching the diffused overcast light, the slope rises behind the dog toward dense green foliage at frame left and right, and the pale cloudy sky sits above the treeline. Immediately the camera begins a smooth, steady 360-degree orbit around <Subject1>, starting from the frontal position and arcing toward the dog's left side while keeping the dog centered in the frame at the same medium-shot distance; long grass blades in the foreground sweep past the lens as the viewpoint moves, a light wind combs through the turf so that successive waves of grass bend and ripple outward from the dog across the hillside, and soft-edged cloud shadows drift steadily across the slope, darkening patches of green and then letting them brighten again as the patches travel. As the orbit continues past the dog's left flank toward a rear three-quarter view, <Subject1> turns its head to follow the camera with warm amber eyes, ears twitching slightly in the breeze and the fluffy white chest ruff lifting in small gusts; the camera keeps moving around the dog's back, where the merle-patterned fur and the continuation of the sloping hillside come into view, then sweeps along the dog's right side while the grass ripples continue in a consistent direction and the cloud shadows keep sliding across the terrain. Finally the orbit completes its full circle and returns to the frontal eye-level medium shot, with <Subject1> still seated upright in the long grass at the center of <Scene1>, panting gently and looking straight at the camera as the wind continues to stir the surrounding blades and moving cloud shadows drift across the green hillside behind it.

# Additional Information
## Duration

## Aspect Ratio

cases.title: 气球汽车
cases.prompt: Have the camera slowly crane up as the car is lifted up into the air by the balloons.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A whimsical live-action magical-realism short film, bathed in warm golden-hour sunset light, carries a dreamy, uplifting, gently nostalgic atmosphere with a pervading sense of wonder.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A small vintage boxy compact car in pale cream-yellow, with a silver metal roof rack, black rubber tires on silver hubcaps, a chrome rear bumper with red taillights, a small black circular fuel cap on the left rear flank, two side doors with simple silver handles, clear glass side windows, and a slightly worn matte paint finish; a driver is visible inside the front cabin with hands on the steering wheel.
<Subject2>: A dense cluster of pastel latex balloons in soft pink, peach, coral, lavender, sky blue, butter yellow, off-white, and dusty rose, each tied with thin white strings that converge and knot together to fasten to the car's roof rack, forming a large rounded bouquet that rises high above the vehicle.
<Scene1>: A quiet suburban residential street at golden-hour sunset, with curved dark asphalt scattered with dry brown leaves, a brick-paved sidewalk on the left, neatly trimmed green hedges and leafy trees, two-storey brown brick houses with dark tiled roofs, white-framed windows, and brick chimneys, a tall curved street lamp, two parked bicycles with silver frames and black tires leaning against the right curb, and a low warm sun near the treeline casting long soft shadows and a pale peach glow across a hazy sky streaked with thin clouds.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a quiet sunlit suburban street <Scene1>, the cream-yellow vintage compact car <Subject1>, tethered to a huge pastel balloon bouquet <Subject2>, lifts off the asphalt and rises slowly into the golden-hour sky while the camera cranes upward with it, carrying a dreamy sense of flight.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a soft, warm orchestral score with gentle strings, celesta, and a light piano melody begins]. A locked-off eye-level wide shot frames <Scene1> at sunset: <Subject1> hovers just above the curved asphalt at center frame, tilted slightly nose-down with its rear lifted higher than its front, all four black tires a short distance off the road while a small cloud of fine dust and kicked-up dry leaves swirls beneath the undercarriage; <Subject2> towers above the roof rack, its pastel balloons packed into a rounded multicolored mass with white strings pulled taut down to the rack, and the low sun at frame left behind the treeline rims the balloons and brick houses with warm golden light. A few pedestrians stand on the left sidewalk in the mid-distance looking toward the car, two silver bicycles rest against the right curb beside a large brown brick house, and the street lamp rises at the left curve of the road. The camera then begins a slow, smooth crane upward, keeping <Subject1> and <Subject2> centered as the car continues to rise: the dust and leaves beneath the wheels disperse, the gap between the tires and the asphalt widens steadily, the car's nose gradually levels out, and the taut strings remain straight under the balloon lift while the pastel cluster sways gently with the ascent. As the climb continues, the rooftops, treetops, and chimneys of the surrounding houses slip lower in the frame, the long shadows across the road shorten from the camera's rising viewpoint, and the warm peach sky fills more of the upper frame; finally the crane settles with <Subject1> suspended well above the street, <Subject2> glowing against the sunset sky, and the quiet neighborhood laid out below as the gentle score sustains.

# Additional Information
## Duration
6.0 seconds
## Aspect Ratio
3:2

cases.title: 雨中撑伞
cases.prompt: 女孩行走在雨中的街道。镜头平移，捕捉少女撑伞前行的动作。雨滴连续落在黑色伞面上，形成水珠滑落的动态，溅起细微水花。她手中的伞随着步伐轻轻晃动，另一只手提着行李箱，街道上不断落下的雨线。整体氛围宁静、略带离别感。
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A Victorian rainy-street cinematic live-action short video carries a quiet, melancholic atmosphere with a pervading sense of parting.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Young woman in her late teens with pale skin, platinum-blonde hair gathered into a low bun with loose strands framing her face, blue eyes, and a calm distant expression; wearing a tall black top hat, a long tailored black coat trimmed with white lace along the collar, lapels and cuffs, a white ruffled cravat fastened with a silver brooch, a black waistcoat with silver buttons, and a large black bow at the back; holding a black umbrella with a curved black handle in her left hand and carrying a brown leather suitcase with dark leather straps, metal rivets and corner protectors in her right hand.
<Scene1>: Narrow cobblestone street in a historic European city during steady rain, flanked by tall weathered stone buildings with ornate cornices and chimneys; wet black cast-iron street lamps with glowing warm-yellow glass lanterns line both sides, a clock tower with a circular face rises in the misty background, and the dark wet pavement reflects the lamp glow in long shimmering streaks beneath a heavy overcast grey sky filled with fine continuous rain.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a rain-soaked historic city street <Scene1>, the young woman <Subject1> walks forward holding her black umbrella and brown leather suitcase while the camera tracks alongside her, raindrops bead and slide off the umbrella canopy, and the wet cobblestones reflect the warm glow of the street lamps.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <steady rainfall patter fills the air, distant city hum softened by wet stone>. A low-angle three-quarter medium shot frames <Subject1> at the center of <Scene1>, her body angled toward frame right with her head turned to look over her right shoulder into the distance; her left hand grips the curved black handle of the open black umbrella above her, its canopy dotted with clear raindrops and a few droplets hanging from the ribs, while her right hand curls around the top handle of the brown leather suitcase held low at her side, the wet leather glistening with rain. The glowing street lamps recede into the mist along both sides of the cobblestone street, the clock tower stands blurred in the grey background, and reflections of warm lamp light stretch across the dark wet pavement beneath her. The camera begins a smooth lateral dolly move traveling with her toward frame right, keeping pace as she starts walking forward; fine vertical rain lines cut through the air, raindrops strike the taut black canopy in a continuous patter, beads of water swell along the fabric and ribs and then slide down the sloped surface, gathering at the edges before dropping off in thin trails that splash faintly against the wet cobblestones below. With each step the umbrella sways gently in her grip, tilting a fraction forward and back, and the suitcase swings slightly at her side while her lace cuffs and the hem of her long black coat catch small flecks of rain; her gaze remains directed ahead and slightly to the right, expression calm and distant, as the stone facades and glowing lamps drift past in soft parallax. Finally the lateral tracking continues to the end of the clip, holding <Subject1> centered against the receding rainy street, the black umbrella canopy still catching continuous rain and the wet pavement reflections shimmering beneath her steady stride.

# Additional Information
## Duration
6.0 seconds
## Aspect Ratio
17:30

cases.title: 办公室互动
cases.prompt: Fixed mid-shot, focusing on the interaction in front of the desk. A woman leans on the edge of the desk with a cigarette, exhaling smoke rings, and says, 'Your article missed the key information I needed.' The man behind the desk, whose hands have been typing continuously, suddenly pauses and looks up, replying, 'I only write what can be published.' There is also vintage jazz playing from a film projector in the room, the 'clack' of the typewriter, the sizzling of the burning cigarette, and the crisp sound of a glass lightly touching the desk.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A noir cinematic live-action short film carries a smoky, tense, vintage atmosphere with a pervading sense of suspicion.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A young adult woman with platinum-blonde hair styled in a voluminous rolled updo with loose waves falling to her shoulders, fair skin, arched dark brows, dark red lipstick, and pearl stud earrings; she wears a black leather jacket and long black gloves, and holds a lit cigarette between her gloved fingers.
<Subject2>: An adult man seen from behind, wearing a dark grey fedora with a black band and a light grey suit jacket with dark sleeve trim, seated at a desk with both hands over a typewriter keyboard; his face is not visible from the camera's position.
<Subject3>: A black manual typewriter with a sheet of blank white paper curled in its carriage, set on the lower desk surface.
<Subject4>: A cut-crystal decanter with a glass stopper holding dark amber liquor, paired with a short rocks glass containing a measure of the same liquor, both resting on the upper desk edge.
<Scene1>: A dim vintage interior office lined with dark floral-patterned wallpaper in muted brown and olive tones; a large gold-framed oil portrait of a woman hangs on the wall at frame left, a small dark oval framed portrait hangs at frame right, and a dark polished mahogany partner desk with brass column supports and round brass drawer pulls fills the midground. The desk holds stacked papers, a small notepad, and a metal cigarette lighter in an open shelf; a dark metal-frame chair with a padded seat sits behind the desk, and warm directional lamplight falls from the upper left, casting deep shadows and catching rising cigarette smoke against the wallpaper.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In a dim vintage office <Scene1>, the blonde woman <Subject1> leans on the mahogany desk holding a lit cigarette and confronts the typing man <Subject2> about his article, while vintage jazz plays under the typewriter clatter; <Subject2> stops typing, looks up, and answers that he only writes what can be published, leaving the two locked in a tense standoff across the desk.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [muffled vintage jazz with brushed drums, upright bass and a slow trumpet line plays from a film projector in the room]. A locked-off eye-level medium shot frames the interaction across <Scene1>: <Subject1> leans on the upper edge of the mahogany desk at frame center, her black-gloved right hand raised to hold the lit cigarette while her left arm crosses beneath it, her gaze directed down toward <Subject2>, and a twisting column of pale blue smoke rises from the cigarette tip toward the upper left; at frame right <Subject2> sits with his back to the camera in the dark metal-frame chair, both hands suspended over <Subject3>'s keyboard with fingers curved, and <Subject4> sits on the desk at frame left beside the gold-framed portrait, the decanter catching the warm lamplight. <typewriter keys clack in a rapid, steady rhythm> and <cigarette tobacco sizzles softly> as <Subject2>'s fingers continue striking the keys in small alternating motions, the blank sheet in the carriage advancing a fraction with each return; <Subject1> tilts her chin slightly, parts her dark red lips, and exhales a rounded smoke ring that drifts upward and expands into the existing smoke column, then speaks in a low, smoky adult female voice: {Your article missed the key information I needed.}; finally her gloved hand lowers a little, the cigarette held level with her shoulder as she holds her gaze on him.

At 4.2 seconds, [the vintage jazz continues at a low volume]. The same locked-off medium shot holds across the desk as <Subject2>'s typing stops abruptly, his fingers freezing above the keys with the last <sharp typewriter clack> cutting off mid-rhythm; he lifts his head, the brim of his fedora tilting upward as his shoulders straighten in the chair, and the jazz, the soft <cigarette sizzle>, and the faint <projector hum> become the only sound for a beat. His right hand then moves from the keyboard toward <Subject4>, fingers closing around the rocks glass, lifting it an inch and setting it back down on the polished desk top with <a crisp glass-on-wood tap>; he replies in a low, gravelly adult male voice without turning away from her: {I only write what can be published.}. Finally his hands settle just above the typewriter keys without resuming typing, <Subject1> remains leaning on the desk edge with the cigarette smouldering and smoke coiling upward between them, and the frame holds on the two figures locked in their positions across the desk as the jazz continues.

# Additional Information
## Duration

## Aspect Ratio

cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A classical chamber performance cinematic live-action short video carries an elegant, serene and refined atmosphere with a pervading sense of musical intimacy.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Young adult woman violinist with fair skin, dark brown hair styled in a neat braided bun, small stud earrings, a delicate gold necklace, and a gold wristwatch on her right wrist; she wears a sleeveless black evening gown with an intricate open-work lace bodice and V-neckline, and plays a polished warm-brown wooden violin with a glossy amber finish, black fingerboard, silver strings, carved spiral scroll, and a horsehair bow with a dark stick and white hair.
<Subject2>: Young adult woman violinist with fair skin, dark brown hair styled in a braided updo, small earrings, and a ring on her left hand; she wears a sleeveless pale champagne pleated evening gown with a wide ornate silver filigree belt at the waist and a bow at the back, and plays a polished warm-brown wooden violin with a glossy amber finish, black tuning pegs, silver strings, and a horsehair bow with a dark stick and white hair.
<Scene1>: Grand ornate concert hall interior with gilded carved columns and mouldings, large classical oil paintings of women in red and blue drapery set in heavy gold frames along the curved upper wall, rows of empty red velvet seats receding into the dim lower hall, and small warm-white spotlights mounted along the gilded cornice; soft warm stage lighting wraps the performers while the painted backdrop falls into a gentle blur.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
Inside the gilded concert hall <Scene1>, two violinists <Subject1> and <Subject2> stand before the gold-framed murals and perform a classical duet as the camera slowly pushes in from a wide two-shot to a close view of their fingers and bows moving across the strings.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a lyrical classical violin duet for two violins begins, warm and legato, with long sustained phrases and gentle bowing]. A locked-off eye-level wide two-shot frames <Subject1> at frame left and <Subject2> at frame right standing before the gilded murals of <Scene1>, both violins raised under their chins with bows drawn across the strings. <Subject1> looks down toward her fingerboard, her right wrist curved as she draws the bow and her left hand set on the neck with fingers pressing the strings, while <Subject2> tilts her head down toward her own violin, left hand curled around the neck and right hand guiding the bow near the bridge; the gold-framed paintings, carved columns, and rows of empty red seats fill the background in soft focus, and warm stage light catches the polished amber varnish of both instruments and the sheen of the black lace and pale champagne gowns. The camera begins a slow, steady push-in toward the pair, the framing tightening gradually from a wide two-shot through a medium shot as the bows continue to travel and the left hands shift along the fingerboards in coordinated phrasing <the continuous soft friction of bow hair on strings and the faint resonance of the hall>.

At 4.2 seconds, [the lyrical violin duet continues, the melody passing between the two instruments in close harmony]. The slow push resolves into a tight close-up that centers the two violins and the moving hands, with the gilded murals softening further into a blurred warm backdrop. <Subject1>'s left hand enters from the lower right of the close frame, fingers lifting and pressing the silver strings in rapid controlled motions while the ring on her finger catches the light, and her right hand guides the bow so that the white horsehair lies flat against the string near the bridge, individual hairs and rosin dust faintly visible as the stick travels back and forth; <Subject2>'s left hand works the fingerboard from the right of frame, fingers tapping and shifting positions, while her bow crosses the strings in a parallel arc, the polished wood of both instruments glowing under the soft light and the carved spiral scroll of <Subject1>'s violin anchoring the upper center of the close view. The camera holds this intimate framing as the bows continue their steady strokes and the fingers keep articulating the melody, the hall's carved gold details and painted figures dissolving into warm bokeh behind the instruments; finally the close view rests on the moving bows and dancing fingers as the duet sustains its final held phrase.

cases.title: 地铁萨克斯
cases.prompt: 镜头慢推到中景，站台灯偶尔闪烁，地铁风带起衣角，人物拿起萨克斯，脸色有些悲伤，开始演奏。音频延展：爵士风格的萨克斯音乐，混着地铁站内的环境回声。
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A melancholic jazz cinematic live-action short video, set in a vintage New York subway station, carries a lonely, nostalgic, and contemplative atmosphere with a pervading sense of late-night solitude.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A middle-aged man with a weathered, sad expression, short greying beard and moustache, dark hair tucked beneath a dark brown fedora, wearing a thick dark charcoal wool overcoat, a dark green knitted scarf, black trousers, and scuffed black leather lace-up boots; he holds a polished brass tenor saxophone with a patinated golden-brass body, engraved keys, and a flared bell.
<Scene1>: An aged underground subway platform interior at night, with worn white square ceramic wall tiles chipped along a black lower dado, a weathered concrete platform with a faded yellow safety line and damp reflective patches, riveted dark green steel support columns, exposed ceiling pipes, and a single glowing incandescent bulb hanging overhead. The left wall is layered with aged signage: a warm orange neon 【BARRA'S】 sign, a rusted 【GOLDWAY】 sign, a glowing pale yellow neon 【SUBWAY】 sign, a green neon partial sign, an orange neon 【PIZZA】 sign, a black tile-mosaic 【42ND ST - TIMES SQ】 sign, two red 【Budweiser】 advertisements with peeling edges, a 【Chesterfield】 cigarette poster, a faded gig poster reading 【GIG POST / GIC POSTER / YGW YORK NOW】, and smaller framed posters. A lit 【SUBWAY】 sign hangs over the tracks, and a dark 【DOWNTOWN】 sign marks the far platform across the tracks. Twin steel rails run into a dark tunnel where approaching train headlights glow as paired warm white points, and pale steam rises from the track bed. Warm tungsten light from overhead bulbs and neon signs mixes with cool shadow, casting long reflections on the wet platform.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On the damp late-night subway platform <Scene1>, the lone saxophonist <Subject1> stands beneath flickering tungsten light as a slow push-in tightens to a medium shot, subway wind lifts the hem of his overcoat, and he lifts his brass tenor saxophone to begin playing a melancholic jazz line that carries through the station with natural tunnel echo.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a melancholic late-night jazz score led by tenor saxophone begins, warm and breathy with slow piano and brushed drums entering underneath]. A locked-off eye-level wide shot frames <Subject1> at frame right on the concrete platform of <Scene1>, leaning his shoulder lightly against a dark green riveted steel column, his left hand gripping the lower body of the brass tenor saxophone so the flared bell hangs at his thigh and the curved neck rises beside his chest; his gaze is directed toward frame left along the platform, his brow faintly furrowed and his mouth set in a sad, distant expression. To his left the twin rails recede into the dark tunnel where paired warm headlights glow in the distance, pale steam drifts up from the track bed, and the left wall's layered neon and enamel signs cast orange, yellow, green and red reflections across the chipped white tiles and damp concrete. The camera begins a slow, steady push-in toward him, the framing gradually tightening from a wide platform view toward a medium shot that settles around his knees upward; the hanging incandescent bulb above flickers at irregular intervals, dimming for a fraction of a second before flaring back to warm tungsten brightness and throwing a moving shadow across his coat and the column, while a draft from the approaching train sweeps along the platform, lifting the hem of his overcoat and the end of his scarf and stirring faint dust along the yellow safety line <a low subterranean rumble, distant tunnel wind, and the soft hiss of steam from the tracks sit beneath the saxophone score>. As the push-in continues, <Subject1> shifts his weight, draws the saxophone upward with his left hand while his right hand rises to support the neck, brings the mouthpiece to his lips, and closes his eyes for a moment with a sorrowful, resigned look; his fingers settle onto the keys, his chest rises in a slow breath, and he begins to play, the first held tenor-sax note swelling with natural tunnel reverb that bounces off the tiled walls and steel columns. Finally the camera settles into a steady medium shot holding <Subject1> at frame right against the green column, the overcoat hem still stirring in the passing train wind, the overhead bulb flickering once more, and the brass bell of the saxophone catching warm neon glints as the melancholic jazz line continues to fill the station.

cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A desert road drama cinematic live-action short video carries a lonely, resolute atmosphere with a pervading sense of isolation.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Adult man in his thirties with a sturdy build, thick dark curly hair, full dark beard and furrowed brows, wearing a worn brown leather jacket over a muted grey button-up shirt and dark blue denim jeans; he holds a large folded paper road map printed with colored route lines and pale cartographic panels.
<Subject2>: Large folded paper road map printed with tan, green and pale blue cartographic panels, red and black route lines, and a white border with small legend blocks; after being crumpled it becomes a compressed paper ball with creased, wrinkled surfaces.
<Scene1>: Straight cracked asphalt desert highway stretching from the foreground to a distant vanishing point, with a faded yellow centerline, deep irregular black cracks across the grey pavement, low sandy shoulders dotted with dry tan scrub bushes and small rocks, and a long range of arid brown mountains under a clear pale blue sky with faint high clouds; warm late-afternoon sunlight casts long shadows and a dry wind moves across the open landscape.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a cracked desert highway <Scene1>, a lost man <Subject1> studies his paper road map <Subject2>, then crumples it in his hand, hurls it aside, and walks off the asphalt into the open scrub while the discarded map bounces, rolls, and drifts slowly in the dry wind.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <dry wind brushes across scrub and asphalt with a faint, open-air hiss>. A locked-off eye-level full shot frames <Subject1> standing centered on the cracked asphalt of <Scene1>, the faded yellow centerline running beneath his boots toward the distant mountains; he holds <Subject2> open wide at chest height with both hands, right hand gripping the left edge and left hand gripping the right edge, head bowed and eyes fixed on the printed panels while the map edges lift slightly in the wind and three tiny distant figures stand far down the road at the right horizon. The camera begins a slow handheld push-in toward him, the framing tightening from full shot to medium shot as his brow stays furrowed; then his right hand releases its edge and folds the map inward, both hands gathering the paper into a tight bundle at waist height, knuckles tightening as the printed panels crumple inward with <dry paper crinkles rising sharply over the wind>. He draws the crumpled ball back beside his right shoulder, twists his torso toward frame right, and hurls it away with a full arm follow-through; the paper ball arcs out over the right shoulder, shrinking against the desert scrub, and <Subject1> lowers his empty hands, lifts his gaze from the road, and turns his body toward the right shoulder of the highway.

At 3.4 seconds, <dry wind continues over the open desert>. A hard cut jumps to a low-angle close-up tracking the discarded <Subject2> on the ground: the crumpled paper ball lands on the cracked asphalt near the right shoulder with <a light papery bounce>, skips once across a black crack, and rolls off the pavement onto the sandy shoulder where loose grains shift around it; the camera follows at ground level as the ball tumbles over small pebbles and past a dry tan scrub bush, its creased surfaces catching the warm sunlight, and finally comes to rest against the base of a low sand dune at the edge of the road. In the background at frame left, <Subject1> is visible from the knees down stepping off the asphalt onto the sand, his denim jeans and dark boots moving away from the highway with <crunching footfalls over gravel and dry earth>; the paper ball stirs again in the wind, rotating slowly on the spot with one corner fluttering, and finally the frame holds on the crumpled map resting against the dune while <Subject1>'s boots continue out of the foreground into the open desert.

cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A quiet natural-history cinematic live-action short film carries a warm, intimate, and gently suspenseful atmosphere with a pervading sense of stillness before sudden motion.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A western honeybee with a fuzzy golden-brown thorax, banded amber-and-black striped abdomen, translucent veined wings, large dark compound eyes, thin black antennae, and six dark segmented legs ending in small hooked feet.
<Scene1>: An interior residential stairwell with a worn dark-brown wooden handrail showing deep grain, scuffs, and a polished highlight where sunlight strikes it, pale off-white turned wooden balusters with chipped paint at their collars, warm medium-brown wooden stair treads receding diagonally upward, a plain plaster wall in muted beige, and a multi-pane window with a light-colored frame at the upper right admitting bright daylight; hazy sunbeams slant across the stairs and handrail, casting sharp-edged shadows and catching fine dust in the air.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a sunlit wooden stairwell <Scene1>, a honeybee <Subject1> resting on the handrail launches into flight, is followed in close-up as it circles through the sunbeams and turns toward the bright window, accelerates, and finally strikes the glass and bounces away.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <soft indoor stillness with faint distant outdoor daylight ambience>. A locked-off eye-level close shot frames <Subject1> on the dark wooden handrail of <Scene1>, the bee positioned slightly right of center and facing toward the lower right of the frame; its six legs grip the raised grain, its translucent wings lie folded over the banded amber-and-black abdomen, and a sharp sunbeam from the upper-right window catches the fuzz on its thorax and casts a small hard shadow beneath its body. The worn handrail runs diagonally from the lower right foreground up toward the upper left, pale chipped balusters stand in the lower-left foreground and midground, and the receding brown stair treads, beige plaster wall, and bright multi-pane window fill the background with slanted bars of sunlight and soft haze. The antennae twitch and the abdomen pulses subtly; then the wings begin to vibrate in a rapid blur, the legs release the wood one by one, and <Subject1> lifts off the handrail, rising a short distance above the rail while the camera pushes in tighter and begins to track with it, keeping the bee in the center of the close frame as it drifts forward into the sunbeam <a delicate, rising wing buzz>.

At 2.2 seconds, <the wing buzz grows louder and steadier>. The close tracking shot follows <Subject1> as it flies through the sunlit air of <Scene1>, the handrail and balusters sliding out of focus and the stair treads and plaster wall blurring into warm brown and beige streaks behind it; the bee arcs in a small circling path, first moving toward the upper left of the frame with its legs tucked beneath the thorax, then banking so that its striped abdomen and veined wings turn in profile, fine dust motes catching the daylight around its wingtips. It completes the loop and then straightens its trajectory toward the bright multi-pane window in the background, the camera pulling back just enough to keep the window frame and slanted sunbeams in view as the bee accelerates along the beam of light, its wings beating faster and its body growing smaller against the bright glass <a rising, tightening buzz>.

At 6.1 seconds, <the wing buzz peaks>. The camera holds a medium close tracking shot as <Subject1> races toward the window, the bright overexposed panes filling the background and the wooden stairwell falling into softer blur at the edges; the bee's body stretches into slight forward motion blur, antennae aimed straight ahead, until it strikes the transparent glass head-on with a sharp contact, its body compressing for an instant and its wings folding against the pane <a crisp, light impact tick against glass>. Immediately after contact <Subject1> bounces backward away from the window, tumbling a short distance through the air with legs splayed and wings briefly disordered, while the camera jolts minutely with the impact and then settles; finally the bee hangs dazed a short distance from the glass, wings beginning to beat again as the bright window and sunlit stairwell remain behind it.

<Subject2>: A worn 3x3 Rubik's cube with chipped and scuffed colored stickers in red, white, blue, green, and faded yellow, its plastic edges scuffed and slightly dirty from handling.

Inside the dim abandoned factory <Scene1>, the rusted yellow robot <Subject1> holds the scuffed Rubik's cube <Subject2> up to its binocular eyes, tilts its head in curiosity, then spins the cube rapidly with its mechanical hand until every face is solved, ending with the robot holding the completed cube up for inspection.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <faint ambient factory hum fills the space>. A locked-off eye-level medium close-up frames <Subject1> centered in <Scene1>, its binocular head tilted slightly toward frame left and both large dark lenses fixed on <Subject2>, which is gripped in its raised right blocky hand at frame left; the cube's mixed red, white, blue, green and faded yellow stickers face the lens in a scrambled arrangement, while the left grey segmented hand rests open near the chest panel where the 【SOLAR CHARGE LEVEL】 display glows faintly, and the rusted yellow torso, treads, and blurred warm-lit factory girders fill the background. The robot's neck joint rotates slowly, tipping the binocular head first one way then the other as the lenses shift minutely in their casings <soft, high-pitched servo whirs>, the right arm holding the cube steady while the head leans closer; then the left hand lifts from the chest and its blocky fingers close around the opposite side of <Subject2>, the two hands bracing the cube between them.

At 2.2 seconds, <the faint factory hum continues under crisp mechanical clicks>. The camera stays fixed on the same medium close-up as <Subject1>'s wrists rotate in rapid alternating twists, the blocky fingers repositioning between turns so that the cube's faces spin in quick successive clicks, colored sticker panels blurring into streaks of red, white, blue, yellow and green as layers snap into place <rapid, precise plastic clicks and small gear ticks from the wrist joints>; the binocular head pulls back a fraction and centers on the spinning cube, the lenses widening slightly while the neck holds steady, and rust flecks catch the warm amber light against the yellow torso. The turns slow, the fingers making one final precise rotation on the last layer, and the cube settles in the robot's hands with each face now showing a single uniform color: one fully red face toward the camera, bordered by clean white, blue, yellow and green faces on the visible sides, the scuffed edges still showing wear but the pattern solved. Finally <Subject1> lifts the solved <Subject2> a little higher in its right hand, tilts its head once more in a small curious motion, and holds the completed cube up before its lenses as the mechanical clicks fade into the low factory hum.

# Style and Tone
Shaw Brothers wuxia-style live-action sequence with a muted, desaturated vintage film grade, taut and suspenseful in mood, presented in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the woman in <Image1>. A young East Asian woman with a serious expression, dark hair styled in two neat side braids coiled at the back of her head, wearing a plain off-white high-collared long-sleeved tunic with frog buttons on her right side, matching off-white straight-cut trousers, and simple white cloth slip-on shoes; her voice is not used.
<Subject2>: References the Chinese straight sword with brass guard and red tassel in <Image2>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image2>. A traditional Chinese jian with a polished double-edged steel blade, a brass ruyi-shaped guard engraved with cloud motifs, a dark wooden grip wrapped at both ends with brass fittings, a brass pommel, and a long red Chinese-knot tassel hanging from the pommel.
<Scene1>: References the bamboo forest clearing with a stone platform in <Image3>. A dense bamboo forest clearing centred on a circular weathered stone platform made of irregular grey slabs edged with moss and scattered dry bamboo leaves; tall dark-green bamboo stalks crowd the foreground and midground on both sides, large mossy rocks sit around the platform edge, soft sunbeams filter through the canopy from above, and the air carries a faint mist; the overall grade is cool and desaturated with deep shadows and dappled highlights, evoking a classic Shaw Brothers wuxia atmosphere.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the woman in <Image1> as <Subject1> (woman). References the Chinese straight sword with brass guard and red tassel in <Image2> as <Subject2> (sword); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image2>. References the bamboo forest clearing with a stone platform in <Image3> as <Scene1> (bamboo clearing). In a misty bamboo forest clearing, <Subject1> (woman) draws <Subject2> (sword) and settles into a tense fighting stance as the camera orbits counter-clockwise around her, pulls back, sweeps behind her and rises into a high-angle view of the lone swordswoman on the stone platform.

# Complete Description
0.0–1.2 seconds, The shot opens at medium-full height on <Subject1> (woman) standing at the centre of the stone platform in <Scene1> (bamboo clearing), feet shoulder-width apart, facing the camera with a stern expression. <Subject2> (sword) is held at her left hip in a ready-to-draw position, blade still sheathed, red tassel hanging still. The camera begins a slow counter-clockwise orbit around her while gently pulling back, keeping her centred; dappled sunlight shifts across her white tunic and the stone slabs. <wind rustling bamboo leaves> [low, sustained Shaw Brothers-style wuxia string drone begins]

1.2–2.8 seconds, Continuing its counter-clockwise orbit and slow backward retreat, the camera reveals more bamboo stalks at the frame edges. <Subject1> (woman)'s right hand grips the hilt of <Subject2> (sword) and draws the blade in one smooth, controlled motion out to her right side, the polished steel catching a shaft of sunlight as it clears the scabbard; her left hand settles into an open palm guard position forward at chest height, her weight lowers into a stable bent-knee stance, and her gaze sharpens forward. The red tassel on <Subject2> (sword) sweeps through the air with the draw. <sharp metallic ring of a blade being drawn> <soft swish of the tassel>

2.8–4.0 seconds, The camera completes its counter-clockwise arc until it moves behind <Subject1> (woman), framing her back at the centre of the platform while still drifting backward; <Subject2> (sword) is now held diagonally across her body, tip raised, in a poised combat-ready posture, her shoulders squared and her head held high. Bamboo stalks now flank her on both sides of the frame and the circular stone platform extends toward the sunlit mist ahead. The string drone thickens with a slow rising tremolo.

4.0–5.0 seconds, The camera continues its backward motion and begins a smooth upward crane, elevating into a high-angle shot that looks down onto <Subject1> (woman) standing alone on the stone platform in <Scene1> (bamboo clearing), <Subject2> (sword) gleaming in her hand, the red tassel hanging motionless as the surrounding bamboo and rocks form a symmetrical, stage-like ring around her. The pull-back finishes on a wide overhead composition that isolates the lone swordswoman against the dappled stone circle and dense bamboo, holding the tense, expectant silence before combat. [strings swell into a single held, suspenseful wuxia sting]

cases.title: 僧人与小猫
cases.prompt: 仰拍低角度丝滑跟随图1僧人和尚的脚步。随着他在图3潮湿的落叶土路上缓慢穿行，镜头逐渐从仰拍变为平视，视野中不断掠过两侧小草和树木。画面保持在和尚后方半米处。在他经过一个树下躺着非常孱弱的小猫时，镜头小幅晃动并随之停住脚步，展现出一种充满神秘苍凉且极具临场感的流浪视角。
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A cinematic live-action sequence with a muted, cool, desaturated colour grade and drifting fog, evoking a mysterious, desolate, immersive wandering atmosphere in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young Buddhist monk in <Image1>. A young East Asian Buddhist monk in his early twenties with a shaved head, calm features, and a slender build, wearing a layered coarse linen robe in muted grey and beige tones tied with a matching sash, simple grey cloth shoes, and a long strand of dark wooden prayer beads with a tassel draped over his left wrist; he moves with slow, deliberate steps.
<Subject2>: References the frail tabby kitten in <Image2>, but not the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image2>. A small, frail tabby kitten with messy, matted grey-brown fur, dark stripes, large pointed ears, pale yellow-green eyes with a sorrowful droop, a pinkish-brown nose, white whiskers, and a thin dark-tipped tail, lying curled and weak on the ground.
<Scene1>: References the misty forest road in <Image3>. A damp, winding dirt path in a misty forest, flanked by tall dark tree trunks receding into thick grey fog, wet fallen brown and yellow leaves scattered across the muddy track, tufts of damp grass and low weeds along both sides, with cool diffused overcast light, low saturation, and deep shadow under the canopy.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the young Buddhist monk in <Image1> as <Subject1> (monk). References the frail tabby kitten in <Image2> as <Subject2> (kitten); does not take the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image2>. References the misty forest road in <Image3> as <Scene1> (misty forest road). A low-angle tracking shot follows <Subject1> (monk) from half a meter behind as he walks slowly along <Scene1> (misty forest road), gradually leveling to eye level, until he nears <Subject2> (kitten) lying beneath a tree, where the camera sways slightly and stops, capturing a somber stray-cat perspective.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.4 seconds, The shot opens at a low upward angle close to the ground, positioned half a meter behind <Subject1> (monk) on <Scene1> (misty forest road); only his lower linen robe hem and grey cloth shoes are prominent in the foreground as he walks forward at a slow, steady pace, with wet leaves and damp grass skimming past the bottom edge of the frame and tall, fog-shrouded tree trunks rising on both sides. The camera tracks forward smoothly in sync with his steps, keeping the half-meter distance, while faint mist drifts across the path and the surface of the muddy road glistens with moisture. <soft rustle of wet leaves under cloth shoes> [low, sustained ambient drone with distant wind]

2.4–5.2 seconds, The camera continues its smooth forward glide behind <Subject1> (monk) and gradually tilts upward from the low angle toward eye level, so that more of his back and sash, then the prayer beads on his left wrist, come into view; on both sides of the frame, blades of damp grass, low weeds, and dark tree trunks slip past continuously as the path curves gently ahead into thicker fog. The monk's pace remains unhurried and even, his robe swaying softly with each step. <cloth brushing against grass, faint squelch of damp earth> [ambient drone deepens subtly]

5.2–6.6 seconds, As <Subject1> (monk) advances, the camera, now near eye level and still half a meter behind him, reveals <Subject2> (kitten) lying curled at the base of a tree to the right of the path, its frail body resting on wet leaves; the camera gives a small, unsteady sway, mimicking a stray creature noticing something, and begins to decelerate. The monk's steps slow in response, his robe's movement becoming more restrained as he nears the kitten. <subtle camera-movement jitter, a single dry leaf skittering on the ground> [ambient drone thins to a hush]

6.6–8.0 seconds, The camera comes to a complete stop half a meter behind <Subject1> (monk), holding a steady eye-level view that frames the monk's still figure from behind in the midground and <Subject2> (kitten) curled weakly under the tree in clear view to the right, with the foggy road and receding trees stretching into the mist beyond; the monk pauses, standing quietly before the kitten, and the damp grass, fallen leaves, and drifting fog settle into a still, somber tableau. <faint distant bird call, soft settling of fabric> [single low, resonant tone fading into silence]

cases.title: 背包转场
cases.prompt: 环绕运镜，一个背着包着急上班的女生@图1，从远处小跑到公司楼下@图2，然后从镜头前面转弯走过，跟随环绕运镜，女生突然停下来在包里翻找什么，镜头推进到寻找包里物品的动作特写，然后镜头丝滑推进到背包内部，再推进到皮包细节，有一种镜头穿越的感觉

# Style and Tone
Cinematic live-action corporate short with smooth, fluid camera motion, warm golden-hour lighting, a brisk and slightly anxious tone, presented in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young office woman in <Image1>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. A young East Asian woman in her late twenties with dark brown hair pulled back with a few loose face-framing strands, fair skin, dark eyes, a soft jawline, and a gentle natural smile baseline; she wears a cream collared blouse with the top button undone and sleeves rolled to the forearms, high-waisted taupe straight-leg tailored trousers ending at the ankle, taupe low-heeled pumps, and carries a smooth black leather shoulder bag over her right shoulder with a matching black strap.
<Scene1>: References the office-building plaza at golden hour in <Image2>. A modern corporate plaza paved with large grey stone tiles in a grid, fronting a glass-and-steel office tower with polished stainless-steel revolving doors under a wide metallic canopy; potted dark-green shrubs sit beside the entrance, cylindrical stainless-steel bollards line the walkway, a long low stone bench runs along frame right with planters of green foliage behind it, tall glass skyscrapers recede down the street, and a leafy tree at frame right filters warm golden late-afternoon sunlight that casts long shadows across the pavement; the colour grade is warm and slightly desaturated with bright sun highlights and soft shadow detail.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the young office woman in <Image1> as <Subject1> (woman); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the office-building plaza at golden hour in <Image2> as <Scene1> (office plaza). <Subject1> (woman) hurries across <Scene1> (office plaza) toward the office entrance, rounds in front of the camera as it orbits her, suddenly stops to rummage in her shoulder bag, and the camera pushes through the bag opening into a close-up of her hand searching inside and finally onto the leather texture of the bag.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.0 seconds, Wide shot at eye level on <Scene1> (office plaza), camera on a smooth circling dolly beginning near frame right and arcing left. <Subject1> (woman) enters from the far background at frame centre, small in frame, jogging briskly toward the camera with her black shoulder bag bouncing at her right hip, her right hand gripping the bag strap; distant pedestrians cross the plaza near the revolving doors and golden sunlight glints off the glass tower. <light footsteps on stone pavement> [subtle rhythmic underscore with a light pulse, tempo matching the jog]

2.0–4.0 seconds, As <Subject1> (woman) reaches the foreground the camera continues its orbit, now at a medium-full shot tracking around her from her left side to her front as she turns to walk across frame from frame left to frame right, passing close in front of the lens; her expression shifts from focused hurry to a flicker of concern, her head tilts down, and her pace begins to falter. <soft rustle of clothing, bag strap creaking>

4.0–5.5 seconds, Medium shot, the orbit resolves into a forward push as <Subject1> (woman) stops abruptly just past centre frame, plants her feet shoulder-width apart, and brings the black shoulder bag around to her front with her right hand while her left hand yanks the top opening wider; her brow knits and her eyes dart down into the bag as she begins rummaging. <bag hardware clinking, fabric shifting> [underscore tightens with a soft rising note]

5.5–7.0 seconds, Close-up, the camera pushes in smoothly toward the bag opening; <Subject1> (woman)'s left hand plunges inside, fingers sifting and pushing past unseen items, her wrist rotating as she searches, knuckles brushing the inner lining while her right hand steadies the bag from outside; her lips part slightly and her shoulders tense. <leather scraping, faint rustle of papers inside the bag>

7.0–8.0 seconds, Extreme close-up with a seamless continuation of the push-in that creates a through-the-opening sensation: the lens travels past <Subject1> (woman)'s searching fingers into the dimmer interior of the bag, then settles on a macro detail of the black leather—fine grain, a subtle sheen from the outside light, the edge of a stitched seam—filling the frame as the motion comes to rest. [underscore resolves into a single held warm tone] <faint whoosh of the camera's forward motion>

cases.title: 草莓饼干
cases.prompt: 以图1产品为主视角生成一条创意广告。粉色背景。开场俯拍一颗巨大的、去蒂的草莓，镜头推进其表面籽粒。草莓瞬间膨胀爆开，飞溅出的不是果浆，而是无数个微型的“奥利奥草莓味”夹心饼干（粉色夹心）。镜头聚焦其中一个，它在空中旋转并组合成完整饼干。结尾推进镜头特写饼干被一只手扭开、露出鲜艳夹心的瞬间，画面中间弹跳出广告文案：草莓味，全新上市。全程一镜到底。

# Style and Tone
A playful, high-energy product commercial in photorealistic CGI with a saturated candy-pink palette, smooth one-take camera flow, and a bright, appetising tone, presented in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the strawberry-flavoured Oreo cookie with pink cream in <Image1>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. A full-sized round sandwich cookie made of two dark chocolate-brown embossed wafers with ridged scalloped edges and a raised central "OREO" medallion surrounded by decorative dots and floral shapes, sandwiching a thick, smooth, bright pink cream layer with tiny flecks.
<Subject2>: References the miniature strawberry-flavoured Oreo cookies with pink cream in <Image1>. A large, stemless whole strawberry with glossy bright red skin, tiny yellow-green seeds set in shallow pits, and a plump conical form.
<Subject3>: A light-skinned human hand with clean, short nails, appearing only at the close-up moment to twist the cookie open.
<Scene1>: A seamless, uniform pastel-pink studio void with no horizon line, lit by soft, even product-advertising light that keeps colours vivid and shadows minimal.

# Overlays
One central overlay layer: bold rounded sans-serif Chinese advertising copy in white with a subtle soft-pink outline, sized to dominate the middle of the frame, popping in from a small scale to full size and holding centered.

# Summary
References the strawberry-flavoured Oreo cookie with pink cream in <Image1> as <Subject1> (cookie); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the miniature strawberry-flavoured Oreo cookies with pink cream from <Image1> for <Subject2> (strawberry). Loosely references the embossed OREO wafer pattern and ridged edge in <Image1>. In a seamless pastel-pink studio, a giant stemless strawberry explodes into a shower of miniature pink-cream Oreos, one of which spins and assembles mid-air into a full-sized cookie that is then twisted open by a hand to reveal its bright pink filling, ending with the launch slogan appearing at centre.

# Complete Description
0.0–1.2 seconds, The shot opens in a top-down overhead view inside <Scene1> (pink void), with <Subject2> (strawberry) centred and filling most of the frame, its glossy red surface dotted with sunken yellow-green seeds; the camera pushes straight down toward the fruit in a smooth dolly-in, tightening on a cluster of seeds as tiny surface highlights glint. <soft whoosh of the camera's forward motion>

1.2–3.0 seconds, As the camera nears the strawberry's skin, <Subject2> (strawberry) inflates rapidly with a visible bulge, then bursts outward in an explosive pop; instead of juice, countless <Subject1> (cookie)-style miniature cookies (each a tiny dark chocolate wafer pair with bright pink cream) spray radially from the centre, tumbling through the pink space at different depths, some close to the lens and others receding. <deep resonant pop followed by crisp tinkling as tiny cookies scatter through the air> [playful upbeat orchestral sting with sparkling chimes kicks in]

3.0–5.2 seconds, The camera tracks one of the miniature cookies at frame centre, following it as it spins rapidly in mid-air; around it, nearby wafer halves and pink cream fragments converge in smooth motion, locking together into a single, perfectly assembled full-sized <Subject1> (cookie) that continues a slow, graceful rotation, its embossed "OREO" top wafer and ridged edge catching the light as the camera circles slightly to keep it centred. <snapping clicks as wafer and cream snap together, soft whoosh of rotation>

5.2–7.0 seconds, The camera pushes in tightly on <Subject1> (cookie) now stationary at frame centre; <Subject3> (hand) enters from frame right, thumb and index finger gripping the top wafer while the other fingers steady the bottom wafer, then twists the two wafers in opposite directions in a smooth quarter-turn, pulling them slightly apart so the thick bright pink cream stretches cleanly between them, revealing its smooth texture and tiny flecks. <subtle crunch of chocolate wafers, soft creamy stretch sound>

7.0–8.0 seconds, The camera holds on the twisted-open <Subject1> (cookie) with the pink cream exposed between the separated wafers, <Subject3> (hand) keeping the halves slightly apart; at the centre of the frame, the advertising copy 【草莓味，全新上市】 pops in with a quick scale-up bounce and settles crisply over the cookie, while the background pink tone glows slightly brighter for the final product hero moment. [music swells to a bright finish with a final chime] <gentle pop of the text appearing>

cases.title: 自由女神机甲
cases.prompt: 低角度电影镜头，图1自由女神像在图2阴天背景下高高耸立，火炬上闪烁着真实的火焰。图1雕像开始机械变形——铜板分裂，齿轮和液压装置显露——变形成一名巨大的机甲战士，一手挥舞巨型长剑，一手持石板作为盾牌，胸口的橙色核心发光，身后可见纽约天际线。（音效：火焰声、铜板分裂声、机械组装声）

# Style and Tone
A cinematic live-action/CGI hybrid transformation sequence in 16:9 framing, with dramatic low-angle framing, moody overcast lighting, and an epic, awe-inspiring tone.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the Statue of Liberty in <Image1>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. A colossal green-patinated copper statue of a robed female figure with a seven-spiked radiate crown, right arm raised holding a torch with a golden flame, left arm holding a rectangular stone tablet inscribed with Roman numerals, standing on bare feet atop a stone base; as the sequence progresses its copper plates split apart to expose interlocking gears, hydraulic pistons and metal framing, and it reconfigures into a towering humanoid mecha warrior with a glowing orange core in its chest, a giant long sword in one hand, and the tablet reforged as a shield in the other, retaining the statue's weathered green-copper and gold color palette.
<Scene1>: References the stone pedestal overlooking a bay under overcast sky in <Image2>. A wide harbor setting centered on the massive weathered brown-stone pedestal with symmetrical white-stone steps, a paved stone plaza, small patches of lawn and a low metal railing at the perimeter; calm grey-blue bay water stretches to a far horizon where the New York City skyline becomes visible in the distance beneath a heavy, overcast sky of layered grey clouds, with cool desaturated color grading and soft diffused daylight.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the Statue of Liberty in <Image1> as <Subject1> (statue-mecha); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the stone pedestal overlooking a bay under overcast sky in <Image2> as <Scene1> (harbor). Under an overcast sky at the harbor, the Statue of Liberty <Subject1> (statue-mecha) stands on its stone pedestal <Scene1> (harbor) with a real flame flickering on its torch, then undergoes a mechanical transformation as its copper plates split open to reveal gears and hydraulics, reconfiguring into a giant mecha warrior wielding a massive sword in one hand and the tablet as a shield in the other while its orange chest core glows and the New York skyline appears behind it.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.0 seconds, A low-angle cinematic wide shot frames <Scene1> (harbor) with the stone pedestal centered at frame bottom, calm grey-blue bay water spreading to both sides, and heavy overcast grey clouds filling the upper frame. <Subject1> (statue-mecha) stands atop the pedestal in its original Statue of Liberty form, crown spikes silhouetted against the sky, right arm raised high with the torch and left arm cradling the tablet. The torch's golden flame is now a real, flickering fire, casting a warm orange glow onto the raised hand. <crackling torch flame, soft wind over the bay>

2.0–4.5 seconds, The camera holds the same low angle and slowly pushes in toward <Subject1> (statue-mecha). Fine seams appear across the green copper surface; copper plates begin to split and peel outward along the robe, crown and raised arm, exposing brass gears, silver hydraulic pistons and dark metal framework underneath. The flame on the torch flickers higher as the torch structure itself starts to reshape. <splitting copper plates, hissing hydraulics, clanking gears, intensified torch flame>

4.5–6.5 seconds, The low-angle camera continues a slow push-in as <Subject1> (statue-mecha)'s transformation accelerates: larger copper panels swing outward like armor plates, the robed torso splits and reconfigures into a broad mechanical chest, the crown spikes rearrange into an angular helmet-like crest, and a bright orange energy core ignites at the center of the chest, casting warm light onto the surrounding metal. The raised right arm reshapes into a mechanical limb while the torch elongates and reassembles into the hilt and blade of a giant long sword, the flame merging into the blade edge. The left arm rotates and the tablet locks onto the forearm, its inscribed face turning outward as a heavy rectangular shield. <heavy metal grinding, hydraulic hisses, gear clatters, a deep resonant hum from the igniting core>

6.5–8.0 seconds, The camera settles into a heroic low-angle static shot as <Subject1> (statue-mecha) completes its transformation into a towering mecha warrior, standing firmly on the pedestal with the giant long sword raised in its right hand and the tablet shield braced on its left arm, the orange chest core pulsing steadily. Through the clearing edge of the cloud layer behind its shoulders, the New York City skyline becomes visible across the bay, while the overcast sky and stone pedestal of <Scene1> (harbor) remain beneath and around it. <resonant core hum, distant city ambience, fading mechanical clanks, the sword blade ringing as it settles>

cases.title: 春日樱花
cases.prompt:
春日公园湖边，满株盛放的红粉双色巨型樱花树，枝桠舒展、花团绵密，花瓣边缘带自然柔光，细节纹理清晰可见（参考图1）；暖灰调天空铺着轻薄云层，柔和漫散射光均匀洒在花瓣、草地与人群身上，无强烈明暗对比，远景构图开阔，游人随性散落聚集，姿态松弛自然，自带慵懒治愈的烟火气。
0-3秒： 众多游客围绕着画中间盛开的樱花树，树下有个美女正对着前镜头摆拍，镜头轻微晃动着记录热闹氛围，游客们调整姿势、交谈、拍照、按快门，画外能听到零星的"再来一张""笑一个"的声音，观众注意力全在樱花和人群上。
3-6秒： 当画面最热闹时，氛围最松弛的时刻，突然，图2奶茶熊从镜头下猛地站起进入中心位置，圆软敦实的身形带着几分憨态，恰好遮挡住后半部分人群与樱花树干，正脸直面镜头，眼神乖巧又略带呆萌茫然，与周遭治愈的樱花场景形成柔和反差，手中高举标语牌「春のお花見に、ミルクティーベア」，字体简洁柔和不突兀。
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
Live-action spring park scene with a photoreal CGI plush character, soft warm pastel grading under diffused overcast light, calm and gently whimsical tone, 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the plush milk-tea bear in <Image2>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image2>. A round, chubby plush bear covered in soft light beige fur, with small rounded ears, large glossy black eyes, a small brown nose, a cream muzzle, a stitched gentle smile, pink blush on both cheeks, pink fabric cherry-blossom flowers attached to its left ear (one blossom) and right ear (one large blossom plus two smaller blossoms), a soft pink cape tied at the neck with a pink cherry-blossom fastener, a cream oval belly patch embroidered with a pink-lidded bubble-tea cup (pink straw, pink cherry blossom on the cup, four dark tapioca pearls) and one extra pink cherry blossom beside the cup, short plush arms and legs, and a soft fuzzy texture throughout.
<Scene1>: References the spring lakeside park with a giant cherry-blossom tree in <Image1>. A wide lakeside grassy park in spring, anchored by a massive central cherry tree with thick dark trunks and widely spreading branches densely packed with pink blossoms ranging from deep rose-pink to pale blush-pink, petal edges catching soft light; foreground and midground covered in short green-brown lawn dotted with smaller cherry trees in full bloom and a few bare-branched trees, groups of casually dressed visitors scattered across the grass (some standing, some walking, some crouching, some sitting by the shore) in relaxed postures; a calm pale grey-blue lake stretching across the background with a low far shore lined with small buildings and trees, rolling grey-blue mountains beyond, and a warm-grey sky filled with thin layered clouds; overall soft diffused overcast lighting with even illumination, no harsh shadows, muted warm pastel colour grade, and a gentle airy depth.

# Overlays
A small rectangular sign held by <Subject1> (bear) at chest-to-head height, with a clean light background and neat, soft, unobtrusive sans-serif lettering in a gentle warm tone; the text reads 【春のお花見に、ミルクティーベア】 and faces the camera directly.

# Summary
References the plush milk-tea bear in <Image2> as <Subject1> (bear); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image2>. References the spring lakeside park with a giant cherry-blossom tree in <Image1> as <Scene1> (park). In a lakeside cherry-blossom park filled with relaxed visitors, a woman poses for photos under the giant blooming tree before a plush milk-tea bear suddenly rises into the centre holding a spring hanami sign, playfully blocking part of the crowd and trunk.

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, Wide long shot at eye level, camera holding a steady centre framing on the giant cherry tree in <Scene1> (park) with very subtle handheld sway. At frame centre the massive two-tone pink cherry tree stands rooted in the lawn, blossoms fully open and dense across every spreading branch; visitors are scattered naturally throughout the midground and foreground — a woman near the base of the tree at centre foreground faces toward the camera posing for a photo, a crouching woman at frame left holds up a phone, a woman in a beige coat and white bucket hat at frame right raises a phone to take a picture, a couple sits cross-legged on the grass near the shore at frame right facing the lake, and small clusters of people walk, talk, adjust their hair and bags, and lift phones or cameras along the lakeside path. # Style and Tone
A retro 8-bit pixel-art animated travel short film carries a warm, nostalgic, adventurous atmosphere with a pervading sense of journey.

<Scene1>: Red-rock desert at sunset; rust-red sandy ground dotted with dark red rocks, tall green saguaro cacti, prickly pear cacti, and low yellow-green scrub; flat-topped red mesas and buttes rise in the distance beneath a deep purple-to-orange gradient sky filled with blocky pixel clouds, with a large round yellow sun sitting low near the horizon; a single straight railway track runs from the lower right toward the left distance.
<Scene2>: Lush green grassland; rolling terrain covered in bright green grass blades that bend in the wind, with small wildflowers and low bushes, distant soft green hills under a clear warm sky, and the railway track cutting straight through the open plain.
<Scene3>: Lakeside sandy shore; pale tan sand beside a calm blue lake whose small waves lap against the edge of the rail bed, smooth pebbles and driftwood scattered on the shore, distant hazy blue hills across the water, and the track running parallel to the shoreline.
<Scene4>: Dense coniferous forest; tall dark green pine and fir trees packed closely on both sides of the track, their trunks dark brown and canopies forming a thick shaded corridor, dappled light falling across the rails, and tree shadows sliding across the train windows.
<Scene5>: Coastal small town; weathered wooden boardwalk buildings with sloped roofs and lit windows lining the track, small pixelated pedestrians in colorful clothing walking along the boardwalk, wooden fences and lampposts, the blue ocean visible beyond the rooftops, and warm evening light over the streets.

No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In a retro 8-bit pixel world, the steam train <Subject1> travels steadily along the track, followed by a smooth side-tracking camera, as the landscape changes in sequence from the red-rock desert <Scene1> at sunset, through the green grassland <Scene2>, the lakeside shore <Scene3>, and the dense coniferous forest <Scene4>, finally arriving at the coastal small town <Scene5>.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a warm, nostalgic chiptune travel melody with steady rhythmic pulses begins]. A locked-off side-tracking medium full shot frames <Subject1> traveling from frame right toward frame left across <Scene1>, with the engine at the right of the train line and the passenger cars stretching leftward into the distance; the large spoked driving wheels rotate continuously, pale tan dust billows up around the undercarriage and trails behind each car, thick black smoke puffs rhythmically from the smokestack and drifts left in connected pixelated clouds, and the warm-yellow windows glow against the rust-red desert while the low sun sits near the horizon and red mesas stand silhouetted against the purple-orange sky. The camera tracks left at the same speed as the train, keeping the engine in a steady position within the right half of the frame as saguaro cacti, prickly pear, red rocks, and scrub slide past in the foreground and midground; the black smoke plume lengthens behind the smokestack, the dust churns in steady waves along the rail bed, and the pixel passengers remain visible through the passing windows until the desert buttes and cacti thin out at the edge of the terrain.

At 3.6 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The same steady side-tracking shot holds on <Subject1> as the red desert ground gives way to <Scene2>: rust-red sand is replaced by bright green grass that rolls in waves across the plain, the sky lightens from deep sunset purple to a warm clear tone, and distant soft green hills replace the flat-topped mesas. Grass blades in the foreground bend and ripple in a continuous wind-driven wave as the train passes, small wildflowers and low bushes slide by beside the track, the driving wheels keep rotating, black smoke continues to puff from the smokestack, and pale dust now mixes with stirred grass particles around the wheels; the camera keeps the engine anchored at the same frame-right position while the open grassland stretches out on both sides, until the green plain begins to slope toward a band of pale blue water at the horizon.

At 6.9 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The smooth side-tracking shot continues without a cut as <Subject1> enters <Scene3>: the grassland opens onto pale tan sand beside a calm blue lake, small pixelated waves lap against the shoreline next to the rail bed, and smooth pebbles and pieces of driftwood slide past in the foreground. The driving wheels keep turning, black smoke still puffs from the smokestack, and fine sand rather than red dust billows around the undercarriage; the blue lake stretches to hazy distant hills on the far side, reflections of the sky shimmer on the water surface, and the lit windows of the passenger cars glide past against the shore until the sand and open water give way to the dark edge of woodland ahead.

At 13.1 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. # Style and Tone
