<Subject2>: An adult man visible only by his right arm and hand in the foreground, wearing a dark tailored suit jacket and a crisp white dress shirt cuff; his right hand is open with the palm facing up and fingers spread, extended toward the central painting from the lower right of the frame.
<Scene1>: A grand classical museum gallery interior with deep burgundy fabric wall panels, dark veined marble pilasters capped with gilded Corinthian capitals, ornate gilded ceiling cornices beneath a grid of frosted skylights, a polished herringbone parquet floor in warm oak tones, a dark marble wainscot along the walls, and a barrier line of polished brass stanchions linked by dark red velvet ropes. Additional oil paintings in heavy gilded frames hang on the left and right walls, including a large group portrait at far left, a smaller cityscape beside it, a small portrait at right, and a large seated-figure painting at far right, each accompanied by a small dark wall placard; soft diffused overhead skylight falls evenly across the room with no harsh shadows.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
Inside the hushed classical gallery <Scene1>, the man <Subject2> extends his open hand toward the central painting <Subject1>, and the painted girl <Subject1> comes alive inside her gold frame, turning her head, lifting her hand toward the canvas surface, and meeting his gesture with a quiet, curious connection while the surrounding gallery remains still.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a soft, elegant chamber score for solo piano and muted strings begins]. A locked-off eye-level wide shot frames the central gallery of <Scene1> symmetrically, with <Subject1> hanging centered on the far burgundy wall inside its ornate gold frame and <Subject2>'s suited right arm entering from the lower right, open palm up and fingers spread as if presenting the painting to an unseen viewer. The brass stanchions and velvet ropes run evenly across the foreground, the herringbone floor reflects the overhead skylight in long warm streaks, and the flanking gold-framed paintings hang motionless on both walls beneath the gilded pilasters and cornice; <Subject1> holds her classic three-quarter pose, eyes directed toward the viewer with lips slightly parted, perfectly still as paint on canvas <a faint, distant gallery hush with no footsteps or voices>. Over the next seconds the camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the central painting, the foreground hand of <Subject2> growing slightly in the lower right while the side paintings and stanchions ease toward the frame edges; the painted girl's eyes begin to shift minutely, her head turns a fraction toward the outstretched hand, and the pearl earring catches a new point of skylight as if the canvas surface has taken on depth, while the rest of the gallery remains undisturbed.

At 5.8 seconds, [the soft chamber score continues with the piano line holding a sustained high note]. The slow push resolves into a medium close-up of <Subject1> within her gold frame, the carved ornament and deep black painted background filling the composition while <Subject2>'s open palm remains visible, blurred, at the lower right edge. The girl's painted shoulders shift beneath the ochre garment, her head turns further toward the hand, and her lips part in a faint, curious expression; she slowly lifts her own hand inside the painting, the painted fingers rising from below the frame line toward the front surface of the canvas until the fingertips press against the implied picture plane, where a soft ripple of warm light passes across the paint as if the surface has become momentarily fluid <a nearly inaudible painterly rustle, like canvas breathing>. The man's fingers twitch once in response, the thumb lifting a little higher, but the arm does not cross the rope barrier; finally her fingertips hold against the inner surface of the painting, eyes locked on the outstretched hand, while the gold frame and burgundy wall remain steady around her.

At 11.2 seconds, [the soft chamber score swells gently then settles]. The camera eases back in a controlled pull-out, restoring the wide symmetrical gallery view of <Scene1> with the flanking paintings, marble pilasters, brass ropes and polished parquet all back in frame. <Subject1> lowers her hand slowly inside the canvas, her head returns partway toward the viewer but keeps a soft, lingering gaze directed at <Subject2>'s palm, and a faint warm glow fades from the pearl earring until the painting looks once again like ordinary oil paint in its gilded frame; <Subject2>'s hand remains open and raised in the lower right, holding the presenting gesture without crossing the barrier, and the chamber score softens to a held piano chord as the gallery returns to stillness. Finally the wide frame rests on the undisturbed classical room, the central portrait restored to its painted pose but with the smallest trace of a smile left on her lips, while the man's open hand stays extended toward her beneath the quiet skylight.

# Style and Tone
A sci-fi virtual-reality journey blending live-action performance with CGI environments, rendered with high-contrast cool palettes in the cockpit and vivid, saturated colours in space, the voxel world, and the final planet, carrying a sense of wonder and accelerating immersion in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young man in <Image1>. A young man in his 20s with light skin, short curly dark-brown hair, faint stubble, and dark brown eyes; he wears a black shirt and, once the transition begins, a sleek virtual sci-fi visor with a thin glowing frame that covers his eyes; his voice is not used in this clip.
<Subject2>: References the green voxel flying dragon in <Image3>. A green blocky voxel dragon with a long segmented tail, outstretched blocky wings, an orange eye, and a red open mouth, built entirely from cubic pixels.
<Scene1>: References the spacecraft cockpit interior in <Image1>. A cramped spacecraft cockpit interior with dark metal bulkheads, coiled ribbed hoses, worn silver switch panels holding a black knob, a lit red indicator, and a lit yellow-green indicator, plus a bright rectangular overhead light; cool blue-green lighting, deep shadows, and a muted desaturated grade dominate the space.
<Scene2>: References the deep blue outer space with planets and asteroids in <Image2>. Deep blue outer space filled with distant stars, wispy cyan nebula clouds, scattered irregular asteroids of varying sizes, several planets including a large Earth-like world and a smaller pale world, and a brilliant central blue-white light source emitting sharp rays and lens flares; the grade is richly saturated with deep blues and bright highlights.
<Scene3>: References the voxel mountain landscape with sea and sky in <Image3>. A bright voxel world built from cubic blocks: a tall grey block-stone mountain capped with a blue cubic structure and a thin antenna, rolling green block-grass hills, terraced slopes, scattered block trees, a blue inland lake, a deep-blue ocean with white wave edges under a sky of floating white cube clouds; bright daylight, vivid saturated colours, and sharp sunlit shadows define the scene.
<Scene4>: References the cracked light-green textured planet in space in <Image4>. Outer space around a large light-green textured planet whose surface shows swirling green and pale land/cloud patterns, a glowing jagged blue lightning-like crack running vertically across its visible hemisphere, dark nebulous clouds on the left, warm golden-yellow nebula glow on the right, a bright blue energy beam entering from the left, and sparse stars across deep black; the grade mixes dark shadows with warm gold and cool blue highlights.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the young man in <Image1> as <Subject1> (man). References the green voxel flying dragon from <Image3> for <Subject2> (dragon). References the spacecraft cockpit interior in <Image1> as <Scene1> (cockpit). References the deep blue outer space with planets and asteroids in <Image2> as <Scene2> (space). References the voxel mountain landscape with sea and sky in <Image3> as <Scene3> (voxel world). References the cracked light-green textured planet in space in <Image4> as <Scene4> (green planet). Inside a spacecraft cockpit, <Subject1> (man) dons a sci-fi visor and the camera orbits closer until it merges with his first-person view, travelling through the visor into deep blue space <Scene2> (space), following ships past asteroids into a blocky voxel landscape <Scene3> (voxel world) where trees audibly grow and a voxel dragon flies overhead, then rushing upward to skim across the cracked light-green planet <Scene4> (green planet).

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, The clip opens on a tight close-up of <Subject1> (man) at frame right inside <Scene1> (cockpit), his face lit by cool blue-green instrument glow as he looks intently toward frame left with a tense, slightly open mouth; the worn silver control panel with its lit red and yellow-green indicators sits at frame left and ribbed hoses recede behind him. The camera begins a slow orbital move around him from a third-person distance, arcing from his left side toward his front while gradually pushing closer. <Subject1> (man) raises his right hand from below frame and brings a sleek virtual sci-fi visor up to his face, settling it over his eyes so its thin frame glows faintly against his skin; his brow tightens as the visor activates. <low cockpit hum, faint electronic whine as the visor powers on>

3.0–6.0 seconds, The orbit tightens into a near close-up and the camera pushes straight into <Subject1> (man)'s visor, the cockpit lights and panel blurring into streaks of blue and white as the third-person view dissolves into his subjective perspective; a brief digital tunnelling effect of light trails rushes forward. The view resolves into <Scene2> (space): deep blue cosmos dotted with stars, drifting asteroids of irregular jagged shapes, and several planets hanging in the distance, with a brilliant blue-white central starburst flaring ahead. Several sleek spacecraft appear in the foreground, their engines glowing blue as they streak away from the camera toward the bright light; the camera accelerates to follow directly behind them, weaving between tumbling asteroids while lens flares bloom across the frame. <whoosh of thrusters, distant resonant space hum, faint asteroid debris scraping past>

6.0–10.5 seconds, Still moving at speed behind the ships, the blue starburst ahead pixelates into bright cubic blocks and the deep space vista reshapes itself into <Scene3> (voxel world): the camera bursts through a bright sky of floating white cube clouds and drops into a low-altitude flight over rolling green block-grass hills, a blue inland lake sliding past on frame left and the deep-blue ocean glinting on frame right. The camera skims low over the terrain toward the tall grey block-stone mountain crowned with a blue cubic structure and antenna; as it passes terraced slopes, blocky trees visibly grow upward from the grass in quick successive bursts, cubes stacking to form trunks and canopies. At frame right, <Subject2> (dragon) flies in the sky above the mountain, wings spread block by block as it banks in the same direction as the camera. The camera tilts upward while still moving forward, aiming at the sky above the mountain peak. <soft crisp sounds of tiny blocks clicking and stacking as vegetation grows, wind rushing past, distant blocky ambient chirps>

10.5–13.0 seconds, From the low voxel terrain the camera tilts fully up and accelerates vertically in a rapid rush; the blocky sky stretches into motion-blurred streaks of blue and white that collapse back into star-filled blackness, revealing <Scene4> (green planet) ahead: a large light-green textured world with swirling surface patterns, a jagged glowing blue crack running down its visible face, dark nebula on the left and warm golden-yellow nebula on the right, with a bright blue energy beam slicing in from frame left. The camera hurtles straight toward the planet, the globe swelling rapidly to fill the frame as stars and nebulous clouds stream past at the edges. <intensifying whoosh of high-speed travel, low building cosmic drone>

13.0–16.0 seconds, The camera reaches the light-green planet and skims across its surface at speed, flying just above the swirling green and pale textured terrain; the glowing blue crack flashes brightly beneath as the viewpoint races along the curve of the globe, with dark space and golden nebula glow sliding past at the upper edge of frame. The trajectory continues to arc along the planet's limb, the surface textures rushing by in a blur of green, white, and electric blue until the clip ends mid-flight over the world. <roaring atmospheric rush, deep resonant planetary hum, crackle of blue energy from the surface fissure>

# Style and Tone
A high-end luxury perfume commercial in live-action, rendered with a Wes-Anderson-inspired pastel palette, rigorous symmetrical framing, elegant vintage colour grading, and a refined, graceful mood in 9:16 framing.

cases.title: 柠檬FPV
cases.prompt:
—15秒一镜到底创意短片。视角跟随（Tracking shot）。0-2秒 起始为主观视角：一个人站在图片起点位置的地面，一只手用力将柠檬抛向空中，镜头极速仰拍。3-12秒 随后进入第一人称无人机（FPV）视角，参考图1——红色线条作为运镜轨迹参考。镜头以第一人称FPV视角呈现，紧贴柠檬在摩天大楼间沿着建筑高速穿梭、侧旋俯冲等等炫酷运动，穿过建筑缝隙，展现城市跑酷感。全画质清晰稳定，无运动模糊，无拖影。超高速运镜，电影级，一镜到底，严格沿着图中的红色路径运动，不要偏离，不要跳步。画面要求写实，运动顺滑稳定，速度感强，不要重复建筑。13-15秒 第一人称无人机（FPV）视角跟随柠檬坠入最终落点，高楼大厦内的一个茶水间桌面的透明饮料杯中（图2），溅出气泡和水花。电影级光影，超现实写实风。音频设计： 全程伴随疾速破风声；镜头高速穿梭时 whoosh 声层层叠加、由远及近；13–15秒柠檬坠入杯中瞬间，清脆落水声与气泡细响，除此之外全片禁止生成多余配乐。
注意：红线和箭头仅作为镜头运动路径指示参考，最终成片中不得出现红线，箭头等。

References a Parisian riverside street with apartment building, flower stall and Seine bench from <Image2>, <Image3> and <Image4> for <Scene1> (Parisian street). Over a single Parisian morning, <Subject1> (woman) walks out of an apartment building holding a coffee cup, stops at a flower stall to pick up a bouquet, and sits on a riverside bench gazing thoughtfully across the Seine.

cases.title: 四季场景步行
cases.prompt: Using the attached character as the subject, generate a continuous walking sequence where the environment transitions seamlessly every 3 seconds: 0–3s desert dunes at sunset, 3–6s neon-soaked rainy city street, 6–9s misty alpine forest, 9–12s clean white infinity studio. Character stride, outfit, and proportions remain identical throughout. Camera tracks alongside in profile, locked focal length, 12 seconds, 16:9.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A cinematic live-action fashion walk sequence with seamless environmental transitions, polished high-fashion lighting per environment, a cool-to-warm tonal range across scenes, and a steady, confident mood in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young woman in western-style attire in <Image1>, but not the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image1>. A young woman in her early twenties with fair skin, defined cheekbones, light blue eyes, neutral lips, and long wavy brown hair; wearing a black wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a high-neck blouse with a white ruffled floral collar and a black-white-orange plaid pattern with oversized balloon sleeves, bright turquoise high-waisted wide-leg trousers, a black leather belt with a silver buckle and a brown leather keeper, and thin hanging chains at each cuff; her proportions, outfit, and stride stay consistent throughout.

<Scene1>: References the desert dunes at sunset in <Image2>. A desert dune landscape at golden sunset, with rippled warm amber sand in the foreground, a small dark-green desert bush on the right dune, rocky dark mountains rising in the midground left, distant mountain ranges across the horizon, a low glowing sun on the right casting long rays, and a sky of scattered clouds tinted orange and gold; warm golden-orange colour grade with soft directional sunlight.

<Scene2>: References the neon-soaked rainy city street in <Image3>. A neon-lit rainy city street at night, with wet black asphalt reflecting pink, blue, magenta and red neon, a red vertical "DINER" sign and cursive "The Diner" neon on the left brick building, a blue-outlined "RAIN MOTEL" sign with "VACANCY KITCHENETTES" on the right, a "West 39th St" street sign, a "ONE WAY" sign, pink steam rising in the mid-distance, tall dark skyscrapers with lit windows, streetlights, traffic lights, and falling rain; deep blue-purple colour grade with high-contrast neon highlights and glossy reflections.

<Scene3>: References the misty alpine forest trail in <Image4>. A misty alpine forest with a narrow brown dirt trail winding between tall straight evergreen trunks, moss-covered rocks and fallen logs on both sides, green ferns and low undergrowth, dense fog softening the background trees into silhouettes, and damp earth under diffused overcast light; cool desaturated green-grey colour grade with soft diffused lighting and visible atmospheric haze.

<Scene4>: References the clean white infinity studio in <Image5>. A clean white infinity studio with seamless white floor, walls and back wall meeting in sharp corners, four recessed circular ceiling lights (two near the left wall, two near the right wall) casting even soft illumination, and no props or decoration; bright neutral white colour grade with flat, shadowless studio lighting.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the young woman in western-style attire in <Image1> as <Subject1> (woman); does not take the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the desert dunes at sunset in <Image2> as <Scene1> (desert dunes). References the neon-soaked rainy city street in <Image3> as <Scene2> (neon rainy city street). References the misty alpine forest trail in <Image4> as <Scene3> (misty alpine forest). References the clean white infinity studio in <Image5> as <Scene4> (white infinity studio). <Subject1> (woman) walks in a steady profile stride as the background seamlessly morphs from desert dunes at sunset to a neon rainy city street, then to a misty alpine forest, and finally to a clean white infinity studio, while her outfit, proportions and walking motion remain unchanged and the camera tracks alongside at a locked focal length.

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, A medium-long profile shot, camera at chest height, locked focal length, tracking smoothly alongside <Subject1> (woman) as she walks from frame right toward frame left at a steady, even stride, her arms swinging naturally by her sides in rhythm with her steps. <Scene1> (desert dunes) fills the entire background: golden rippled sand stretches across the ground, the desert bush sits on the right dune, dark rocky mountains rise on the left horizon, the low sun glows on the right, and scattered sunset clouds drift slowly; warm sunset light rakes across <Subject1> (woman), matching the desert palette while her outfit, proportions and hat remain exactly as established. <wind softly stirring sand> [a slow, warm atmospheric synth pad begins] As the 3.0 second mark approaches, the sand, mountains and sky begin to dissolve smoothly into the next environment without a cut, <Subject1> (woman)'s stride uninterrupted.

3.0–6.0 seconds, The shot size, angle, focal length and tracking speed remain unchanged as the background completes its seamless transition into <Scene2> (neon rainy city street): wet reflective asphalt now lies under <Subject1> (woman)'s feet, neon signs ("DINER", "The Diner", "RAIN MOTEL", "West 39th St") glow on either side, pink steam rises down the street, tall dark buildings line the road, and rain falls visibly around her. <Subject1> (woman) continues the same steady profile walk, her sleeves and trouser hems moving identically, the neon pink and blue light now colouring her silhouette while her outfit and proportions stay unchanged. <rain pattering on pavement, distant city hum> [the warm synth pad shifts into a darker, pulsing synthwave beat with a slow bassline] Toward 6.0 seconds, the neon lights, wet street and rain begin to blur and blend into the next environment in a continuous dissolve, her walking motion never breaking.

6.0–9.0 seconds, Camera continues tracking at the same locked focal length and distance as the transition resolves into <Scene3> (misty alpine forest): the dirt trail now runs beneath <Subject1> (woman), tall mossy evergreen trunks line both sides, ferns and fallen logs cover the banks, and thick fog drifts between the receding trees. <Subject1> (woman) maintains her identical profile stride, arm swing and posture, with the same hat, plaid blouse, turquoise trousers and belt, now lit by cool diffused forest light; a faint mist passes in front of her without altering her silhouette. <soft forest breeze, distant bird call> [the synthwave beat fades into a quiet, airy ambient texture with sustained strings] As 9.0 seconds nears, the trees, moss and fog wash smoothly into bright white, again without a cut or change in her walk.

9.0–12.0 seconds, The tracking shot, focal length and <Subject1> (woman)'s stride, outfit and proportions remain perfectly consistent as the environment settles into <Scene4> (white infinity studio): seamless white floor and walls surround her, four recessed ceiling lights cast even soft illumination, and no other objects are present. <Subject1> (woman) continues walking in profile at the same pace across the clean white space, the studio light rendering her colours true and her silhouette crisp. <subtle studio ambience> [the airy ambient texture resolves into a clean, held single tone that fades gently] The shot holds to the end with <Subject1> (woman) still mid-stride, background fully white, movement smooth and continuous to 12.0 seconds.

cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
Spider-Verse-inspired cel-shaded animation with cyberpunk palette, graffiti textures, chromatic-aberration color fringing, and bold halftone edge lines; dynamic, high-energy, immersive, in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the blue-haired cyberpunk girl in <Image1>, but not the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. A young woman with short spiky bright blue hair streaked with faint purple highlights, pale skin, sharp violet eyes, and a serious expression; wearing a black ribbed turtleneck crop top with black geometric chest armor and shoulder pads, thin glowing cyan lines tracing the outfit, black tactical shorts, a heavy black utility belt with pouches and canisters, black thigh holsters with straps holding a sidearm on her right thigh, black armored leggings with knee plates and cyan light strips, and black chunky tactical boots; a holographic data pad with purple and cyan readouts sits on her left forearm.
<Scene1>: References the cyberpunk Shanghai street canyon with wet reflective asphalt, graffiti, and landmark tower in <Image2>. A narrow cyberpunk Shanghai street canyon flanked by tall buildings mixing old brick-and-fire-escape architecture with modern glass skyscrapers, a large colorful graffiti mural on the left wall, a closed metal shutter, a "WALKER ST" sign on the right, wet glossy asphalt reflecting the facades, and a distinctive pearl-and-spire landmark tower visible down the long straight avenue in the distance; cool overcast daylight with warm rim light on the left buildings, high contrast, saturated cyan-magenta color grade, and visible chromatic fringing along edges.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the blue-haired cyberpunk girl in <Image1> as <Subject1> (girl); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the cyberpunk Shanghai street canyon with wet reflective asphalt, graffiti, and landmark tower in <Image2> as <Scene1> (Shanghai street canyon). References the Spider-Verse-style chromatic aberration edge effect, cyberpunk palette, and graffiti aesthetic in <Image1> and <Image2>. A blue-haired cyberpunk girl, <Subject1> (girl), falls through a glitchy chromatic-fringed void and lands in a cyberpunk Shanghai street canyon, <Scene1> (Shanghai street canyon),, where she immediately begins parkour running away from the camera as it dynamically follows her from behind down the avenue past graffiti-covered walls and tall buildings toward the distant landmark tower.

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, Opening on a full-body view of <Subject1> (girl) standing centered against a stark white void, arms crossed, the holographic pad glowing purple on her forearm; subtle Spider-Verse-style chromatic aberration edges flicker around her silhouette. The ground beneath her feet suddenly fractures into glitchy RGB-split shards, she gasps and her arms fling outward, her eyes widen, and she drops through the opening frame into a dark vertical tunnel of drifting neon particles, streaking cyan and magenta light trails, and scrolling graffiti-text fragments, the camera tilting downward to track her plunge as her hair and clothing whip upward from the wind. <whooshing wind> [low pulsing synth bass with rising pitch]

3.0–7.0 seconds, Continuing the fall in a medium tracking shot from slightly behind and above <Subject1> (girl), she tumbles and rights herself, arms bracing forward, legs bending as she accelerates; the void around her warps with color-split halftone edges, floating street-sign shapes and building silhouettes rush past, and a bright horizontal band of city light grows rapidly below. <Subject1> (girl) extends her legs and lands in a crouch on wet glossy asphalt, both hands slapping the ground for impact, water splashing outward in slow-motion droplets that catch cyan and magenta fringing; the camera lands with her in a low rear three-quarter angle, revealing she is now inside <Scene1> (Shanghai street canyon) with graffiti on the left wall, tall buildings on both sides, and the landmark tower glowing far down the avenue. <heavy splash of puddle water, distant city hum> [synth stab on impact, then a steady cyberpunk beat kicks in]

7.0–11.0 seconds, Rising into a low over-the-shoulder shot from directly behind <Subject1> (girl) as she pushes off the asphalt with both hands, springs upright, and breaks into a sprint straight down the center of <Scene1> (Shanghai street canyon); the camera tracks dynamically behind her at shoulder height, matching her speed, her blue hair streaming back, her right and left arms pumping in rhythm, her boots splashing through reflective puddles that mirror the buildings. She glances briefly over her left shoulder toward the colorful graffiti mural on the left wall, then veers slightly left, plants her left boot on the curb, and launches into a parkour vault over a low street bollard, hands touching down briefly before she clears it and continues running; chromatic aberration streaks trail her edges with every sharp move, and halftone dots pop around the speeding foreground. <boots pounding wet pavement, splashing puddles, fabric rustle> [upbeat cyberpunk hip-hop beat with heavy bass and vinyl crackle]

11.0–15.0 seconds, The camera pulls back slightly to a wider rear tracking shot as <Subject1> (girl) accelerates down the long straight avenue of <Scene1> (Shanghai street canyon), the "WALKER ST" sign whipping past on the right edge of frame, fire escapes and brick facades streaming by on both sides, and the pearl-and-spire landmark tower growing larger straight ahead. She leaps onto the hood of a parked car at center lane, pushes off with her right foot, and lands in a roll that carries her back into a full sprint, the holographic pad on her forearm flickering to life with purple data as she runs; chromatic-fringed speed lines and graffiti-style graphic streaks radiate outward, the wet reflections below mirror her silhouette, and the shot holds on her receding back as she charges toward the glowing tower at the far end of the street, the camera still following her from behind in continuous motion. <footsteps clanging on car metal, tires skidding softly, hologram beep> [beat swells with a rising synth lead, ending on a held cyberpunk tone]

# Style and Tone
The cinematic extreme-offroad automotive commercial, rendered in photoreal next-gen CGI, carries a bold, heroic and relentless atmosphere with a pervading sense of unstoppable momentum.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A glossy black Rising Auto F7 fastback sedan with a long coupe-style roofline, slim LED headlamps, a diamond-pattern illuminated front grille, a stylized R badge on the hood, a white front license plate reading 【Rising Auto F7】, black side mirrors, flush door handles, a full-width rear light bar, and large multi-spoke silver-and-black alloy wheels with black tires. Its body progressively accumulates splattered dark mud, pale frost and fine yellow desert sand as it drives through successive terrains.
<Scene1>: A polished dark stone waterfront overlook at sunset, with wet reflective tile paving, a low glass-and-stone balustrade, a wide calm bay, a distant illuminated city skyline, a leafy tree at the right edge catching warm sunset light, and a dramatic sky of deep indigo, lavender and peach streaked clouds lit by low golden dusk light.
<Scene2>: A storm-lashed dark forest mud track at night, with dense black tree trunks, tangled branches, deep rutted brown mud, driving diagonal rain, low lightning-lit storm clouds, and cold blue-grey illumination broken by brief white lightning flashes.
<Scene3>: A steep snow-covered mountain pass in a heavy snowstorm, with white drifts banked along a narrow icy road, dark jagged rock faces, falling thick snowflakes, and cold pale blue-white overcast light.
<Scene4>: A sun-scorched cracked desert plain under a blazing pale yellow sky, with fissured dry earth, low heat haze, sparse dead scrub, and harsh bright golden daylight that casts sharp shadows.

# Overlays
At the end of the video, bold rugged sans-serif title text appears centered over the frame, displaying the English line 【Unstoppable.】 above the Chinese line 【征服未境，无畏前行。】 in a heavy chiseled typeface with a warm metallic sheen and a subtle impact shockwave glow.

# Summary
The black sedan <Subject1> launches from the sunset waterfront overlook <Scene1> and charges through a stormy mud forest <Scene2>, a blizzard-swept mountain pass <Scene3>, and finally a cracked sun-baked desert <Scene4>, its glossy black body progressively caked with mud, frost and sand while a side-tracking camera keeps it locked at frame center, until the final desert side profile holds beneath the bold title 【Unstoppable.】 / 【征服未境，无畏前行。】.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a low, building cinematic orchestral score with deep brass and driving percussion begins]. A locked-off eye-level three-quarter front shot frames <Subject1> centered on the wet dark stone paving of <Scene1>, its illuminated diamond grille and slim LED headlamps lit, the white 【Rising Auto F7】 plate mounted at the front bumper, and the sunset bay, lit city skyline and right-edge tree reflected in the glossy black paint and polished tiles <a deep, resonant engine idle rumbles beneath the score>. The tires bite against the stone, the front end lifts slightly, and <Subject1> accelerates forward directly toward the camera before the viewpoint sweeps smoothly around the front three-quarter arc into a perfect side-tracking profile; as the camera locks onto the car at frame center, the waterfront, balustrade and sunset sky begin to streak laterally, and the polished tile surface dissolves in a seamless motion-blur wipe into dark rutted mud.

At 3.2 seconds, <the engine note hardens into a full-throated roar and heavy rain hisses across the track>. The side-tracking shot holds <Subject1> dead-center in profile as it charges through <Scene2>: dense black tree trunks whip past on both sides, diagonal rain streaks slash across the lens, and the tires carve through deep brown mud, throwing thick rooster tails upward along the flanks <wet tire spray and thick mud splatter>. Dark wet mud spatters progressively onto the lower sills, wheel arches, doors and rear quarter panels, streaking upward in long arcs while the illuminated headlamps cut two bright cones through the rain and occasional lightning flashes bleach the forest in cold white; the camera keeps pace exactly, the car's silhouette steady against the rushing dark trees until the mud, rain and trunks blur into a white-and-blue snowstorm wipe.

At 6.8 seconds, <the engine roar continues over howling wind and the crisp crunch of tires on ice>. The same locked side-tracking framing keeps <Subject1> centered as it climbs through <Scene3>: thick snowflakes stream horizontally past the body, the road narrows between dark rock faces, and the tires bite into packed snow and ice, kicking up fine white plumes that settle onto the hood, roof, window frames and wheel spokes <compressed snow spray and icy wind rush>. Pale frost creeps over the already mud-streaked black paint, whitening the leading edges of the bumper, mirror caps and window trim while the mud remains visible beneath the accumulating ice, and the headlamps glow through dense falling snow; the snowy rock faces then bleach into bright overexposed gold as the scene wipes forward into blazing desert light.

At 10.3 seconds, <the engine roar opens into a wide, dry-throated snarl over hot wind and grit blast>. The side-tracking shot continues to hold <Subject1> centered in profile as it races across <Scene4>: cracked fissured earth rushes past beneath the wheels, heat haze shimmers above the plain, and fine yellow sand billows from the tires in dense trailing plumes that coat the lower body, wheel faces, sills and rear deck <sand scouring against bodywork and hot wind rush>. The accumulated mud and frost remain under a fresh layer of gritty golden dust, so the black paint now carries a layered record of wet brown splatter, pale frosted edges and thick yellow sand, while the flush door handles, multi-spoke wheels and fastback roofline stay sharply defined against the bright desert; the camera holds the running profile without cutting, the car's stance low and planted as it surges onward. Finally the side profile settles into a heroic held composition, the layered mud, frost and sand clearly visible across the body, and the bold centered title 【Unstoppable.】 / 【征服未境，无畏前行。】 slams onto the screen with a heavy metallic impact thud that resonates under the sustained engine roar as the frame holds on the dust-charged, still-charging sedan.

# Style and Tone
The wuxia duel cinematic live-action short film, set in a torrential bamboo forest, carries a tense, sharp, and storm-laden atmosphere with a pervading sense of imminent confrontation.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Young adult male swordsman in his twenties with a lean build, pale skin, sharp dark brows, a straight nose, and a firm jawline; long jet-black hair tied in a high ponytail secured by an ornate silver hair ornament, with wet strands clinging to his face and neck; wearing a layered white hanfu robe with subtle embroidered patterns, wide soaked sleeves, and a white silk sash at the waist; wields a long straight jian with a silver hilt, its blade slick with rain.
<Subject2>: Young adult male swordsman in his twenties with a lean athletic build, pale skin, thick dark brows, a high nose, and a set jaw; long loose jet-black hair hanging past his shoulders, completely soaked and plastered to his neck and back; wearing a layered black hanfu robe with wide dark sleeves and a dark braided leather belt fitted with silver ornaments at the waist; wields a long slightly curved dao with a dark wrapped hilt, rain beading and running along its edge.
<Scene1>: Dense outdoor bamboo grove at night during a heavy downpour; tall dark green bamboo stalks rise on both sides with long narrow leaves, wet dark earth and scattered puddles cover the ground, and a faint blurred stone structure sits in the misty background; cold blue-grey ambient light filters through the rain, casting wet highlights on soaked fabric and steel while the background dissolves into sheets of falling water and mist.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In the rain-soaked bamboo grove <Scene1>, the white-robed swordsman <Subject1> and the black-robed swordsman <Subject2> face each other with drawn blades, exchange sharp words, and then clash in a fast exchange of thrusts, sweeps, blocks, and a final overhead collision that splits the falling rain, driven by aggressive traditional percussion and erhu music.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [fast, forceful traditional Chinese percussion led by large bass drums begins, layered with a sharp, aggressive erhu melody that drives the duel forward]. <heavy drumming rain fills the bamboo grove, with continuous water patter on leaves, fabric, and puddles>. A locked-off eye-level medium two-shot frames <Subject1> at frame left and <Subject2> at frame right in <Scene1>, standing face-to-face only a short distance apart with rain pouring vertically between them and water streaming down their soaked hair and robes. <Subject1> holds his silver-hilted jian vertically in front of his torso with both hands, the blade pointing upward and rain sheeting along its polished edge, while <Subject2> grips his dark-hilted dao with the blade angled diagonally down toward the wet ground at his side, droplets running off the tip to strike the puddled earth; bamboo leaves tremble under the downpour on both sides of the frame, and the two men hold rigid combat stances with their shoulders squared and gazes locked on each other, neither blinking as the camera begins a very slow, almost imperceptible push-in.

At 4.0 seconds, [the fast drum-and-erhu score continues, the erhu line tightening higher as tension mounts]. <rain continues to hammer the grove, and wet bamboo leaves rustle and sway under the downpour>. The camera begins a smooth slow orbit around the pair, arcing from the frontal two-shot toward <Subject1>'s right side while keeping both swordsmen centered in a medium shot; bamboo stalks and dripping leaves slide past the foreground on both sides, and the rain streaks diagonally across the lens as the move progresses. Both <Subject1> and <Subject2> turn their heads minutely to maintain unbroken eye contact, their sharp gazes following each other across the shifting angle, water dripping from their chins and the edges of their sleeves; <Subject1>'s jaw tightens, and in a cold, low, steady adult male voice he says {你看起来还是一如既往的弱啊。}, his lips barely moving as the words cut through the rain; finally the orbit settles into a three-quarter view that holds both fighters in profile against the curtain of falling water.

At 8.0 seconds, [the drum pattern accelerates into rapid rolling strikes and the erhu surges into a higher, more aggressive line as the duel breaks open]. <rain continues to pour, now joined by sharp metallic clashes and the heavy splash of boots in mud and puddles>. Without a cut, the same continuous camera follows the action as <Subject1> launches the first attack: he steps forward with his front foot splashing through a puddle and drives his jian straight toward <Subject2>'s chest in a direct thrust, the wet blade cutting a silver line through the rain. <Subject2> twists his torso sharply to the side to evade, water flinging from his long black hair and sleeve, and answers with a reverse-grip horizontal sweep of his dao aimed at <Subject1>'s waist; <Subject1> brings his jian vertically downward to block, the two blades meeting with a bright metallic crack that throws a spray of raindrops outward, then immediately rotates his wrists and converts the block into a heavy downward cleave toward <Subject2>'s shoulder. <Subject2> pushes off the wet ground and leaps backward, both boots clearing a puddle that splashes upward beneath him, and lands several paces away with his dao held low; the two exchange a rapid flurry of thrusts, parries, and circular sweeps, their blades weaving intersecting arcs of reflected steel as rain is sliced into fine mist around them, and <Subject1> finishes the sequence with an upward lifting flick of his jian that forces <Subject2> another step back, mud dragging under his retreating boot. <Subject2>'s expression hardens into a snarl, and in a deep, shouting adult male voice he roars {那你猜猜今天究竟鹿死谁手！}; he then surges forward, boots pounding through the puddled earth, and brings his dao down in a powerful overhead cleave. <Subject1> raises his jian to meet it, and the two blades collide violently in the air between them at chest height, the impact sending a visible shockwave that splits the curtain of falling rain outward in a radial burst, water droplets spraying in all directions while both men press their weight against the crossed blades, faces set and rain streaming down their locked stares; finally the frame holds on the crossed swords at the center of the bamboo grove, rain continuing to pour over the two straining figures as the drums and erhu drive to their peak.

The sofa dips and rocks with each landing, small waves slosh against its sides, and both women settle back against the ribbed backrest with their legs extended and their cans once more in hand, laughing as the sofa drifts a short distance from shore; finally the floating sofa steadies on the swell with both women seated and facing each other.

At 10.0 seconds, [the upbeat summer pop music swells lightly]. A hard cut jumps to a high-angle slightly overhead wide shot looking down on <Scene1>, the blue ocean filling most of the frame with white surf lines receding toward the pale sand beach in the background. <Subject3> floats centered on the clear blue water, <Subject1> leans back against the left armrest and <Subject2> against the right, both turning toward each other and raising their cans toward the middle of the sofa; the aluminum rims meet with a bright clink, droplets flick from the tops, and together in cheerful unison they say {沙滩海洋，快乐随时切换！} as they laugh and tilt the cans toward their lips. The camera holds the high overhead composition, the orange sofa drifting slowly with the small swells and the bright sun glinting off the water and the wet vinyl; finally the frame rests on the two women laughing and clinking again, the beach and blue sky framing the floating sofa from above as the music carries the moment to the end.

# Additional Information
## Duration
12.0 seconds
## Aspect Ratio
30:17

cases.title: 人机剑斗快切甩镜
cases.prompt:
主战场是图2里的一片狭窄泥路空地。
图1中男主从画面一侧高速冲入战场，机械人从正前方迎击。
两人始终在同一片长着高草的空地中缠斗，机械人与男主真人大小一致。
男主使用长剑，机械人也使用真实的金属长剑，剑保持原样，呈暗淡的金属光泽，没有发光效果、没有能量特效、没有额外特效。
战斗节奏必须极快，通过快切、甩镜、前景遮挡、蒙太奇的方式，呈现“乱而有章法、看不清完整动作”的高光剑影感。

镜头1｜0.0s—2.0s
开场侧面冲刺拔剑

侧面机位，中景跟拍，机位位于男主左侧。
男主沿着狭窄泥路在高草中高速冲刺，衣摆、斗笠和发丝被暴雨打得凌乱飞动，脚步踩进泥水不断溅起水花。镜头与男主同向高速移动跟拍。
冲刺过程中男主右手瞬间握住剑柄，在奔跑中快速拔出长剑，动作极短、极狠、极快，没有预备姿势，没有停顿。拔剑瞬间只看到一抹冷暗的剑光掠过，动作要有真实的惯性与力量感，类似老港片武侠作品里边冲边出剑的高能开场。
结尾让镜头捕捉到男主拔剑后继续冲向前方敌人的状态。

镜头2｜2.0s—4.0s
正面对冲，第一轮试探交锋

与镜头1不同，切到男主正前方偏右的低角度机位。
机械人从前方的雨雾和高草中迎面逼近，真实机械质感强烈，动作充满压迫感、稳定、杀气极重。男主冲到近前的瞬间，机械人毫无停顿，直接一记力量极大的斜劈砍下。
男主以极快的身法侧闪避开，同时长剑顺势贴着机械人躯干掠过，砍在机械人的金属身体上，发出沉闷的反弹声与类似火花的金属擦撞感，但不要夸张特效，只需呈现真实的金属反弹效果。
这一镜要突出：

机械人的攻击重、狠、致命
男主的闪避快、灵、贴身
男主砍中机械人身体后有明显的反弹感，不是轻飘飘划过

镜头3｜4.0s—7.0s
蒙太奇快切，机械人疯狂无脑压迫砍杀，男主贴身穿梭闪避反击

这一段采用多机位蒙太奇快切，但每个切镜都只保留极短的高光动作，不要拖沓。

机位A：微俯拍全景
从上方斜俯拍两人的战斗轨迹，机械人像一台只会压迫式疯砍的机器般连续追杀，左右横扫、上劈、反劈、贴身追砍，不搞花架子，只追求致命压迫感。男主围绕机械人身体快速变向，如同在机械人身边游走。

机位B：近距离侧后方手持
镜头贴近机械人肩后，拍到机械人一剑接一剑地重砍，男主在极近距离下低头、沉肩、转胯、滑步，从剑锋边缘连续擦身闪过。

机位C：低角度近景
男主贴地滑步，机械人的剑锋从头顶和肩侧掠过，雨水被剑风切开。男主趁躲闪的间隙，快速一剑砍向机械人的肋侧、腰侧、手臂关节，剑砍在机械金属躯体上，呈现出真实硬碰硬的震手反弹感。

机位D：超近特写蒙太奇

剑锋擦过机械人金属外壳
机械人手臂发力挥剑
男主鞋底踩进泥水急停变向
雨珠、泥点、衣摆、剑身快速甩动
男主与机械人一触即分的擦身瞬间

这一整段的观感必须是：
机械人疯狂致命地乱砍，男主快到几乎看不清动作，在机械人身边不停躲闪和削砍，画面乱而有章法，快而不虚假。

镜头4｜7.0s—10.0s
机械人重击震飞男主

切到全新的侧面大动态机位，不重复前面的视角。
侧面拍摄两人中距离缠斗，机械人突然抓住节奏，单手或双手蓄力一记极重的横劈或斜劈砍向男主。男主举剑格挡，下一瞬就被那股巨大的冲击力直接震飞出去。
动作重点：

机械人这一劈像重锤一般，力道极大
男主不是自己跳开，而是被明显“震飞”
身体腾空后摔落地面，落地要有真实的翻滚和泥水冲击感
剑、身体、衣摆、泥水都要有真实惯性
这一镜要明确打出“机械人力量压制”的压迫感。

镜头5｜10.0s—15.0s
高能收尾：空中插剑—地面躲避—胯下滑出—对峙站起

这一段必须一气呵成，快速、紧张、刺激，不要拖沓。

动作核心要求
机械人
机械人必须是与真人同比例大小的真实机械改造人
不是巨大怪物，不是机甲
每一剑都像是要人命的疯砍，压迫感极强
攻击逻辑是无脑压迫、连续致命砍杀、力量极大
剑保持原样，呈暗淡金属质感，无发光无特效

男主
男主速度必须快到看不清完整动作
主要依靠灵活身法：侧闪、沉肩、转胯、滑步、低头、贴身换位、擦身反击
砍中机械人身体时，要有真实的反弹效果
轻功动作必须有真实的腾空、落地、蹬地、翻身、滑行、起身的物理感
结尾“被震飞—躲插剑—胯下滑出—身后站起”必须一气呵成

风格统一要求
整个环境必须是枯草丛生而且长得很高
画面充满江湖意境，如同雨夜荒野中的武侠决斗
参考《倩女幽魂》的阴冷、潮湿、荒凉、神秘气质
全片无慢镜头
全片通过快切、甩镜、前景遮挡、蒙太奇强化战斗高光
观感是：快、狠、乱、真、刺激、刀光剑影、看不清却招招到位
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A live-action wuxia duel rendered in cold, desaturated, rain-soaked tones, combining gritty realism with rapid Hong Kong-style swordplay montage, handheld kinetic camera work, and a 9:16 framing that emphasizes claustrophobic, high-tension close combat.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the wandering swordsman in <Image1>, but not its plain grey studio backdrop. An East Asian man in his thirties with weathered, grimy skin, a sharp jaw, thick dark brows, deep-set eyes, a thin mustache and a small goatee; long, messy black hair falls in damp strands around his face. He wears a tattered dark brown woven straw hat, layered ragged robes in faded grey and black with frayed hems, a dark sash at the waist, wrapped lower legs, and worn dark cloth boots. He carries a long straight sword in a dark scabbard with a wrapped grip; the blade has a dull dark steel finish with no glow. His voice and demeanor are silent and focused.
<Subject2>: References the cyborg swordsman in <Image3>, but not its glowing blue energy sword or plain grey studio backdrop. A human-sized cyborg swordsman with a polished dark navy and brushed bronze mechanical body, a featureless angular metallic face mask, exposed mechanical joints at the neck, elbows, wrists, and knees, a dark topknot held by a mechanical hairpiece with hanging pins, segmented navy armor plates with silver trim, a high standing collar, a long armored skirt with layered plates, thick corded cables at the waist, and bronze-and-dark-blue mechanical hands and feet. He wields a long real-metal longsword with a dull non-glowing metallic blade and a wrapped hilt.
<Scene1>: References the rainy marshland path with a thatched hut in <Image2>. A narrow muddy path cutting through tall, dry brown reeds and marsh grass, with a small weathered thatched hut on wooden posts to one side, dark forested mountains rising behind drifting fog and heavy rain; the palette is cold desaturated green-grey, with dim diffused storm light, wet surfaces, constant vertical rain streaks, and deep mist obscuring the distance.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the wandering swordsman in <Image1> as <Subject1> (swordsman). References the cyborg swordsman in <Image3> as <Subject2> (cyborg). References the rainy marshland path with a thatched hut in <Image2> as <Scene1> (marshland path). In a storm-lashed marshland path, <Subject1> (swordsman) charges and duels the relentlessly attacking <Subject2> (cyborg) with blindingly fast close-quarters swordplay, is struck and knocked back by a heavy blow, then evades a plunging strike, slides beneath the opponent, and rises behind <Subject2> (cyborg) to face him in a tense standoff.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.0 seconds, The shot opens in a side medium tracking shot positioned to <Subject1> (swordsman)'s left, moving forward at high speed down the muddy path of <Scene1> (marshland path). <Subject1> (swordsman) sprints through the tall reeds at frame centre, his tattered robes, straw hat, and loose hair whipping violently under heavy rain; his boots hammer into the mud, splashing dark water upward with every stride. His right hand snaps to the hilt of his sword and, mid-sprint without any preparatory pause, he rips the long blade free in one short, brutal motion; a single glint of dull steel flashes across the frame as the blade clears the scabbard. Rain streaks diagonally across the lens, foreground reeds whip past to create partial obstructions, and the camera keeps pace with him as he continues driving forward toward the unseen enemy ahead. <heavy rain drumming on reeds and mud, cloth snapping in wind, the sharp metallic ring of a sword being drawn>

2.0–4.0 seconds, The shot cuts abruptly to a low-angle front-three-quarter view from <Subject1> (swordsman)'s front-right, the camera planted low on the mud. Through sheets of rain and swaying tall grass at frame centre, <Subject2> (cyborg) advances with heavy, steady, menacing steps, his mechanical joints glistening wet, sword held ready in a low guard. As <Subject1> (swordsman) closes the distance at full sprint, <Subject2> (cyborg) unleashes a powerful downward diagonal slash without hesitation, the blade cutting rain as it arcs. <Subject1> (swordsman) twists his body sharply, dropping his shoulder and sliding his lead foot to flash past the strike at close range, then drives his own dull steel blade horizontally across <Subject2> (cyborg)'s armored torso; the sword bites with a heavy metallic rebound, throwing a brief, sparse shower of real metal sparks and a visible jolt up <Subject1> (swordsman)'s arms before the two spring apart a half-step. <thudding mechanical footfalls in mud, a heavy whoosh of blade displacing rain, a loud dull clang of steel on armor, brief metallic scrape, rain hissing>

4.0–7.0 seconds, A rapid-fire montage of extremely short cuts begins, each shot lasting only a fraction of a second and linked by hard whip-pans and foreground reed occlusions. From a slightly high angled wide view above the path, <Subject2> (cyborg) presses forward relentlessly, delivering continuous horizontal sweeps, overhead chops, reverse-angle slashes, and close-range pursuit cuts with no flourish, while <Subject1> (swordsman) circles and changes direction around him in tight arcs through the mud. A close handheld shot from over <Subject2> (cyborg)'s rear shoulder shows one heavy swing after another hammering past inches from <Subject1> (swordsman), who ducks his head, drops his weight, rotates his hips, and glides his feet to slip just beyond each blade edge. A low-angle close shot catches <Subject1> (swordsman) sliding low on the wet ground as <Subject2> (cyborg)'s sword shears rain just above his scalp and beside his shoulder, then snapping quick counter-cuts into <Subject2> (cyborg)'s ribs, waist, and arm joints, each impact producing a hard metallic jolt and small real sparks. Extreme close-ups flash in quick succession: a dull blade edge scraping across dark armor plate, a mechanical forearm tensing and rotating as it swings, <Subject1> (swordsman)'s muddy boot sole stamping into a puddle to reverse direction, raindrops and mud flecks exploding off swinging cloth and steel, and the two fighters brushing past each other shoulder-to-shoulder before separating. <rapid overlapping clangs and scrapes of steel on metal, squelching mud under quick feet, heavy blade whooshes cutting rain, cloth and straw hat flapping, continuous drumming rain>

7.0–10.0 seconds, The montage cuts to a new dynamic side angle, framing the two fighters at mid-distance along the path of <Scene1> (marshland path). <Subject2> (cyborg) suddenly plants his lead foot, winds up with both hands on his sword hilt, and unleashes a devastating horizontal-to-diagonal cleave with enormous force. <Subject1> (swordsman) raises his long sword in a two-handed block to meet the strike; the moment the blades collide, the impact visibly hammers through his arms and body, lifting him off his feet and hurling him backward through the rain. He tumbles through the air, robes and hat trailing, and crashes into the muddy path several paces away, rolling hard across the wet ground in a spray of dark water and loose reeds, his sword still gripped in his hand as mud and rainwater splash around him. <a thunderous metallic impact, a sharp grunt of exertion, body slamming into wet mud, splashing water, rain continuing to hammer down>

10.0–15.0 seconds, Without slowing, the sequence drives into a continuous fast chain with whip-pans and tight foreground grass occlusions. <Subject2> (cyborg) closes the gap instantly and raises his sword high, then drives it straight down in a plunging stab at <Subject1> (swordsman) on the ground; <Subject1> (swordsman) twists his torso sharply to the side, the blade plunging into the mud right beside him with a heavy thud and splatter. Before <Subject2> (cyborg) can recover, <Subject1> (swordsman) plants one hand on the wet ground, drives his legs, and slides low and fast between <Subject2> (cyborg)'s legs, his body skimming the mud as he passes underneath, trailing a streak of dark water. Emerging behind <Subject2> (cyborg), <Subject1> (swordsman) pushes off the ground with one foot, rotates his body upward in a tight, grounded rise, and comes to his feet in one fluid motion a short distance behind the cyborg, sword held ready at his side, robes dripping and mud-streaked. <Subject2> (cyborg) halts his downward strike, plants his sword for an instant, then begins to turn; the final beat lands on both fighters in a tense rear-three-quarter framing, <Subject1> (swordsman) now standing behind <Subject2> (cyborg) on the narrow path, rain pouring down between them and tall reeds swaying in the foreground as they lock into a still, charged standoff. <sword plunging into wet mud with a thick schlop, body sliding fast through muck, wet cloth scraping, quick heavy breathing, clink of armor rotating, rain drumming steadily, a final low resonant hum of tension under the storm>

cases.title: 楼梯追逐五镜调度
cases.prompt:
[@图1]是被追者，受伤缠着绷带，面部有伤痕；[@图2]是追击者，穿白T恤牛仔裤。在昏暗潮湿的楼梯间[@图3]，追逐戏开始。

镜头1：被追者踉跄奔上楼梯，手撑扶手借力，身后脚步声逼近。

镜头2：追击者快步跨阶追击，俯身冲刺，眼神紧锁定前方。

镜头3：被追者在楼梯转折处被逼停，背靠墙壁喘息，脸上痛苦与恐惧交织。

镜头4：追击者逼近，被追者突然发力，推倒垃圾桶阻挡，趁机转身继续逃。

镜头5：两人在狭窄楼梯间追逐，脚步声、喘息声、扶手撞击声交织，湿滑地面溅起水花。

整体节奏紧张激烈，动作连贯有力，光影在昏暗灯光下交错。
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A tense live-action chase sequence with gritty, desaturated colour grading, high-contrast shadow play from overhead fluorescents, and visceral, urgent pacing in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the injured pursued man in <Image1>, but not the plain white reference-sheet backdrop of <Image1>. An East Asian man in his 40s with short black hair, a lean, hardened build, and visible abrasions and cuts across his face and forearms; both hands are wrapped in stained white hand wraps, he wears a form-fitting dark charcoal short-sleeve T-shirt, slim black denim jeans, and worn, mud-caked black athletic sneakers; his voice carries a ragged, breathless, mid-range male timbre.
<Subject2>: References the pursuing man in white T-shirt and jeans in <Image2>, but not the light grey reference-sheet backdrop of <Image2>. An East Asian man in his 30s with short neat black hair, an athletic build, wearing a plain white short-sleeve crew-neck T-shirt, medium-blue straight-cut denim jeans, and clean white low-top sneakers; his voice carries a sharp, focused, mid-range male timbre.
<Scene1>: References the dim damp concrete stairwell in <Image3>. A narrow, neglected concrete stairwell with chipped dark-green and off-white painted walls, a worn silver metal handrail along the left, damp and grimy concrete steps with peeling edges, a wet reflective landing floor, exposed pipes and conduits running along the walls and ceiling, a barred window at the far end of the upper landing, and cold flickering overhead fluorescent tubes casting hard shadows and a greenish-grey, low-saturation, moody light; a dented metal trash bin sits near the stair landing corner.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the injured pursued man in <Image1> as <Subject1> (injured man); does not take the plain white reference-sheet backdrop of <Image1>. References the pursuing man in white T-shirt and jeans in <Image2> as <Subject2> (pursuer); does not take the light grey reference-sheet backdrop of <Image2>. References the dim damp concrete stairwell in <Image3> as <Scene1> (stairwell). In a dim damp concrete stairwell, an injured bandaged man, <Subject1> (injured man), flees upward while a man in a white T-shirt, <Subject2> (pursuer), pursues him at speed, until <Subject1> (injured man) is cornered at a turn, shoves a trash bin into <Subject2> (pursuer)'s path, and the chase continues up the wet steps.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.8 seconds, The shot opens on <Scene1> (stairwell) from a low angle looking up the first flight of stairs, the camera hand-held and slightly shaky. <Subject1> (injured man) stumbles into frame from frame right, lunging upward onto the steps; his right hand slaps hard onto the metal handrail to lever his weight forward while his left arm swings for balance, his wrapped hands scraping the rail, his body hunched with effort. His face shows a pained, fearful grimace, fresh sweat glistening on the bruised cuts. Behind him, from the lower landing off-frame, <rapid, heavy footsteps> echo up the stairwell, mixed with <dripping water> and the distant <hum of a flickering fluorescent tube>.

2.8–5.2 seconds, The camera cuts to a medium tracking shot from behind and slightly low, following <Subject2> (pursuer) as he bursts onto the same flight from frame bottom. He takes the stairs two at a time in a driving sprint, torso leaned sharply forward, knees lifting high, arms pumping; his eyes are locked forward up the stairwell, jaw set, expression hard and intent. His white sneakers slap the concrete edges, and <fast, hard footfalls> overlap with <ragged breathing> as the camera tilts upward with his momentum, keeping him centred while the green walls streak past at the frame edges.

5.2–7.6 seconds, The camera cuts to the stair landing at the turn, framed as a tight medium shot with the chipped wall at frame right and the next flight rising at frame left. <Subject1> (injured man) skids onto the landing, boots splashing on the wet floor, and is forced to a halt as he realises the next flight is exposed; he presses his back flat against the wall at frame right, shoulders heaving, one wrapped hand bracing against the wall beside him, the other clutching at his side. His face contorts in a mix of pain and terror, eyes wide and fixed down the stairs he just came up, mouth open as he sucks in air; <shallow, gasping breaths> and the <flicker-buzz of the overhead light> fill the narrow space while the sound of <approaching footsteps> grows louder.

7.6–10.0 seconds, The camera holds on the landing at eye level, tightening slightly as <Subject2> (pursuer) rounds the bend from frame bottom and closes in, slowing only slightly as he reaches the landing, his weight coiled to lunge. Just as he steps within reach, <Subject1> (injured man) suddenly twists his body, plants his left foot, and drives both wrapped hands forward into a dented metal trash bin sitting at the corner of the landing; the bin tips and slams across the wet concrete directly into <Subject2> (pursuer)'s path with a <loud metallic crash>, spilling debris. <Subject2> (pursuer) throws an arm up to shield himself and stutter-steps to avoid tripping, and in that instant <Subject1> (injured man) spins on his soaked heels and throws himself up the next flight, his sneakers <splashing in puddles> as he turns the corner out of immediate reach.

10.0–13.0 seconds, The camera becomes a fast, low tracking shot rushing up the next narrow flight, framing both men in a compressed depth of field: <Subject1> (injured man) scrambles upward a few steps ahead, repeatedly grabbing the handrail to haul himself around the next bend, his shoulder <banging the metal rail> with each lunge; <Subject2> (pursuer) drives up right behind, clearing the fallen bin and leaping over the spilled trash without breaking stride. The wet steps throw up <splashes of dirty water> under their shoes, and the soundscape layers into a dense, rhythmic chaos of <pounding footsteps>, <harsh overlapping breathing>, <the clatter and scrape of hands and bodies against the handrail>, and <water splatters>, while the flickering fluorescent light sweeps alternating bars of cold white and deep shadow across their faces and the peeling green walls as they disappear upward around the next turn.

cases.title: 山路跑车四机位
cases.prompt:
顶级跑车商业广告，多机位连贯剪辑，纯视觉动作表现，禁止生成背景音乐、对白与旁白，音效需生成跑车引擎轰鸣，且需与车速、距离、镜头机位变化合理匹配。
【总体场景与主体】：一辆极具流线型与攻击性的（图1）银色保时捷（Porsche 911 Spyder）跑车。环境是阴天、深邃崎岖的（图2）山谷盘山公路，空气中带有微凉的水汽，柏油路面湿滑。整体色调为冷峻的高级灰与暗青色。
分镜 1（0–3秒 · 远景/航拍 Aerial WS）
上帝视角俯瞰，（图1）跑车沿山谷蜿蜒公路单一方向匀速前行。引擎声遥远、低沉，作为空间定位。
分镜 2（3–6秒 · 正面跟拍 Frontal Tracking MS）
切至与（图1）跑车同向行驶的正面跟拍，距离约5米，车速与分镜1一致。车头清晰，LED大灯点亮，路面水花轻微溅起，背景（图2）山体因（图1）跑车在极速行驶时与山体的视角中而产生适度动态模糊的感觉。
分镜 3（6–9秒 · 侧面平移 Side Panning Shot）
（图1）跑车驶入弯道，镜头在弯道外侧做平行摇摄，（图1）车身主体保持清晰，背景树林、岩壁模糊；轮胎高速旋转，胎纹与湿地接触真实，水雾向后扬起，不遮挡整车轮廓。
分镜 4（9–12秒 · 后方跟拍转远景 Rear Tracking → WS）
切至（图1）跑车后方低角度跟拍，（图1）车辆沿弯道继续驶离，镜头先跟拍1.5秒后缓慢后拉并升高，（图1）跑车逐渐远去，尾灯在雾中变为两点红光后淡入（图2）山谷阴霾。引擎轰鸣随距离递减

A sleek, aggressively styled silver Porsche 911 two-door sports coupe with a low aerodynamic profile, rounded LED headlight assemblies with circular inner lamps, black lower air intakes, a small gold Porsche crest on the smooth bonnet, silver side mirrors, silver multi-spoke alloy wheels with red brake calipers visible behind them, black tyres with clearly defined tread, a sloping roofline, a rear deck with horizontal engine vents, slim horizontal red LED taillights, a silver rear bumper, and four round chrome exhaust tips arranged as two dual outlets.
<Scene1>: References the misty mountain valley with a winding asphalt road in <Image2>. # Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the silver Porsche 911 sports car in <Image1> as <Subject1> (sports car); does not take the plain white studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the misty mountain valley with a winding asphalt road in <Image2> as <Scene1> (mountain valley). References the cool dark grey and cyan colour grade in <Image2>. A silver Porsche 911 sports car, <Subject1> (sports car), drives at a constant speed along a wet winding mountain road, <Scene1> (mountain valley), through a cloudy, misty valley, shown in four connected multi-angle shots as its engine sound fades with distance into the haze.

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, Aerial wide shot from a high god's-eye perspective, camera gliding smoothly forward above <Scene1> (mountain valley) while looking straight down. <Subject1> (sports car) sits small against the landscape, moving at a steady constant speed along the wet winding asphalt in a single direction, its silver body catching faint cool reflections as it follows the road's curves between the dark forested slopes. The road's glossy surface, the rocky stream, the steep rock face on the left, and the mist-shrouded distant peaks are all visible below. <low, distant engine rumble resonating through the valley, establishing the car's position far below>

3.0–6.0 seconds, Hard cut to a frontal tracking medium shot, camera positioned directly ahead of <Subject1> (sports car) at roughly five metres and travelling forward at the same speed so the car stays centred in frame. <Subject1> (sports car)'s front end is sharply defined: the silver bonnet, the gold crest, the two round LED headlights now lit with bright white light, the black lower intakes, and the front tyres. Fine arcs of road water spray outward from the tyre contact patches as the car moves over the wet tarmac. The mountainsides and trees of <Scene1> (mountain valley) stream past on both sides with moderate motion blur from the high relative speed, while low mist hangs along the valley edges. <engine note rises to a closer, deeper, evenly pitched growl matched to the steady speed, faint tire hiss and light water splash under the body>

6.0–9.0 seconds, Cut to a side panning shot from the outside of an upcoming bend, camera level with the car's shoulder and panning horizontally in lockstep as <Subject1> (sports car) enters and carves through the curve. <Subject1> (sports car) remains sharp across the full side profile — silver doors, silver mirror, multi-spoke wheels, sloping roof, rear deck vents, and the red taillight edge — while the background trees and wet rock walls of <Scene1> (mountain valley) streak horizontally into soft blur. The tyres spin rapidly, tread clearly engaging the glossy wet asphalt, and a controlled mist of water is thrown backward and outward from the wheel arches without covering the car's silhouette. <engine sound hardens into a crisp, aggressive mid-range roar synchronized with the cornering load, continuous tire spray whoosh, faint wet-gravel tick against the wheel arches>

9.0–12.0 seconds, Cut to a low rear tracking shot, camera positioned close behind <Subject1> (sports car) and moving with it for the first 1.5 seconds, showing the silver rear bumper, the four round exhaust tips, the horizontal rear vents, and the slim red taillights glowing against the mist. After 1.5 seconds the camera begins a smooth backward pull while simultaneously rising in altitude, gradually opening from a tight rear view into a wider view of <Scene1> (mountain valley). <Subject1> (sports car) continues along the curving road and grows smaller as it pulls away; the two red taillights shrink into a pair of small red points softened by the valley haze until the silver body dissolves into the low grey clouds and dark forest. <engine roar is loud and present at the start of the shot, then steadily decreases in volume and deepens in tone as the distance grows, water spray from the tires softening into a faint hiss that fades into the valley's damp air>

# Complete Description

A locked-off over-the-shoulder medium shot frames <Subject1> from behind at frame left in <Scene1>, his dark-suited shoulder and the back of his slicked light-brown head softly blurred in the foreground, while <Subject2> sits clearly in focus across the small marble table at frame right; the stained-glass panels curve behind her, the set plates, cutlery, tumbler and two etched wine glasses sit between them, and the cool window light catches the lace yoke of her dress and the green clip in her bobbed hair. <Subject1> holds the short tumbler with both hands near the table edge and speaks in a low, steady male voice {After tonight, you can't stay here anymore.}, his fingers tightening faintly around the glass <a faint glass clink as his thumb brushes the rim>. <Subject2> has her wine glass lifted halfway to her lips, the amber liquid catching the light; at the line her hand stops mid-motion, her gaze drops from his face toward the glass and the tabletop, her lips part slightly, and she holds the pause without drinking, the shallow depth of field keeping her lowered eyes and still fingers sharp while his blurred shoulder anchors the left foreground; finally she remains frozen with the glass raised, eyes down, as the beat closes.

Are you leaving with me?}, her fingers still curled around the stem <a light glass-on-table chink as the base settles>. <Subject1> holds the short tumbler in front of him on the table, his face turned toward her; he holds eye contact for a beat, his jaw tightening faintly, then his gaze drifts away from her toward the window and the blurred street beyond, his fingers loosening on the tumbler without lifting it to drink, the shallow depth of field keeping his averted eyes and still hands sharp while her blurred shoulder anchors the right foreground; finally the frame holds on his turned-away face and the quiet table between them as the clip ends.

# Style and Tone
A retro 8-bit pixel-art animated travel short film carries a warm, nostalgic, adventurous atmosphere with a pervading sense of journey.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A vintage steam locomotive with a string of dark maroon passenger cars; the engine has a black boiler with brass domes, a tall smokestack, a glowing round headlamp, a cowcatcher at the front, large spoked driving wheels, and a tender behind it; each passenger car has a row of lit warm-yellow windows with pixelated passengers visible inside, dark roofs with small vents, and undercarriage wheels; thick black smoke puffs from the smokestack and pale tan dust billows around the wheels.
<Scene1>: Red-rock desert at sunset; rust-red sandy ground dotted with dark red rocks, tall green saguaro cacti, prickly pear cacti, and low yellow-green scrub; flat-topped red mesas and buttes rise in the distance beneath a deep purple-to-orange gradient sky filled with blocky pixel clouds, with a large round yellow sun sitting low near the horizon; a single straight railway track runs from the lower right toward the left distance.
<Scene2>: Lush green grassland; rolling terrain covered in bright green grass blades that bend in the wind, with small wildflowers and low bushes, distant soft green hills under a clear warm sky, and the railway track cutting straight through the open plain.
<Scene3>: Lakeside sandy shore; pale tan sand beside a calm blue lake whose small waves lap against the edge of the rail bed, smooth pebbles and driftwood scattered on the shore, distant hazy blue hills across the water, and the track running parallel to the shoreline.
<Scene4>: Dense coniferous forest; tall dark green pine and fir trees packed closely on both sides of the track, their trunks dark brown and canopies forming a thick shaded corridor, dappled light falling across the rails, and tree shadows sliding across the train windows.
<Scene5>: Coastal small town; weathered wooden boardwalk buildings with sloped roofs and lit windows lining the track, small pixelated pedestrians in colorful clothing walking along the boardwalk, wooden fences and lampposts, the blue ocean visible beyond the rooftops, and warm evening light over the streets.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In a retro 8-bit pixel world, the steam train <Subject1> travels steadily along the track, followed by a smooth side-tracking camera, as the landscape changes in sequence from the red-rock desert <Scene1> at sunset, through the green grassland <Scene2>, the lakeside shore <Scene3>, and the dense coniferous forest <Scene4>, finally arriving at the coastal small town <Scene5>.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a warm, nostalgic chiptune travel melody with steady rhythmic pulses begins]. A locked-off side-tracking medium full shot frames <Subject1> traveling from frame right toward frame left across <Scene1>, with the engine at the right of the train line and the passenger cars stretching leftward into the distance; the large spoked driving wheels rotate continuously, pale tan dust billows up around the undercarriage and trails behind each car, thick black smoke puffs rhythmically from the smokestack and drifts left in connected pixelated clouds, and the warm-yellow windows glow against the rust-red desert while the low sun sits near the horizon and red mesas stand silhouetted against the purple-orange sky. The camera tracks left at the same speed as the train, keeping the engine in a steady position within the right half of the frame as saguaro cacti, prickly pear, red rocks, and scrub slide past in the foreground and midground; the black smoke plume lengthens behind the smokestack, the dust churns in steady waves along the rail bed, and the pixel passengers remain visible through the passing windows until the desert buttes and cacti thin out at the edge of the terrain.

At 3.6 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The same steady side-tracking shot holds on <Subject1> as the red desert ground gives way to <Scene2>: rust-red sand is replaced by bright green grass that rolls in waves across the plain, the sky lightens from deep sunset purple to a warm clear tone, and distant soft green hills replace the flat-topped mesas. Grass blades in the foreground bend and ripple in a continuous wind-driven wave as the train passes, small wildflowers and low bushes slide by beside the track, the driving wheels keep rotating, black smoke continues to puff from the smokestack, and pale dust now mixes with stirred grass particles around the wheels; the camera keeps the engine anchored at the same frame-right position while the open grassland stretches out on both sides, until the green plain begins to slope toward a band of pale blue water at the horizon.

At 6.9 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The smooth side-tracking shot continues without a cut as <Subject1> enters <Scene3>: the grassland opens onto pale tan sand beside a calm blue lake, small pixelated waves lap against the shoreline next to the rail bed, and smooth pebbles and pieces of driftwood slide past in the foreground. The driving wheels keep turning, black smoke still puffs from the smokestack, and fine sand rather than red dust billows around the undercarriage; the blue lake stretches to hazy distant hills on the far side, reflections of the sky shimmer on the water surface, and the lit windows of the passenger cars glide past against the shore until the sand and open water give way to the dark edge of woodland ahead.

At 10.0 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The steady tracking shot carries <Subject1> into <Scene4> as tall dark green conifers close in on both sides of the track, their dark brown trunks and dense canopies forming a shaded corridor; dappled patches of light slide across the roofs and sides of the passenger cars, tree shadows sweep across the glowing windows in quick succession, and the underbrush and lower pine boughs brush past in the foreground. The driving wheels continue their steady rotation, black smoke puffs up through gaps in the canopy, and the forest grows denser before the trunks begin to space out again, revealing warmer light ahead as the trees thin toward the edge of the woods.

At 13.1 seconds, [the warm chiptune melody continues]. The same smooth side-tracking camera follows <Subject1> out of the forest and into <Scene5>, where weathered wooden buildings with sloped roofs and lit windows line the track on the landward side and the blue ocean becomes visible beyond the rooftops; wooden boardwalk planks, lampposts, and fences slide past in the foreground, and small pixelated pedestrians in colorful clothing walk along the boardwalk, their figures drifting backward relative to the train. The engine's headlamp glows against the warm evening town light, the driving wheels keep turning along the track that now runs beside the street, black smoke continues to trail from the smokestack, and the passenger cars with their glowing windows glide past the storefronts; finally the frame holds on <Subject1> still advancing steadily through the coastal town, with wooden houses, pedestrians, and the ocean sliding backward at a constant pace as the chiptune melody sustains.
