# Style and Tone
The wuxia duel cinematic live-action short film, set in a torrential bamboo forest, carries a tense, sharp, and storm-laden atmosphere with a pervading sense of imminent confrontation.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Young adult male swordsman in his twenties with a lean build, pale skin, sharp dark brows, a straight nose, and a firm jawline; long jet-black hair tied in a high ponytail secured by an ornate silver hair ornament, with wet strands clinging to his face and neck; wearing a layered white hanfu robe with subtle embroidered patterns, wide soaked sleeves, and a white silk sash at the waist; wields a long straight jian with a silver hilt, its blade slick with rain.
<Subject2>: Young adult male swordsman in his twenties with a lean athletic build, pale skin, thick dark brows, a high nose, and a set jaw; long loose jet-black hair hanging past his shoulders, completely soaked and plastered to his neck and back; wearing a layered black hanfu robe with wide dark sleeves and a dark braided leather belt fitted with silver ornaments at the waist; wields a long slightly curved dao with a dark wrapped hilt, rain beading and running along its edge.
<Scene1>: Dense outdoor bamboo grove at night during a heavy downpour; tall dark green bamboo stalks rise on both sides with long narrow leaves, wet dark earth and scattered puddles cover the ground, and a faint blurred stone structure sits in the misty background; cold blue-grey ambient light filters through the rain, casting wet highlights on soaked fabric and steel while the background dissolves into sheets of falling water and mist.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In the rain-soaked bamboo grove <Scene1>, the white-robed swordsman <Subject1> and the black-robed swordsman <Subject2> face each other with drawn blades, exchange sharp words, and then clash in a fast exchange of thrusts, sweeps, blocks, and a final overhead collision that splits the falling rain, driven by aggressive traditional percussion and erhu music.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [fast, forceful traditional Chinese percussion led by large bass drums begins, layered with a sharp, aggressive erhu melody that drives the duel forward]. <heavy drumming rain fills the bamboo grove, with continuous water patter on leaves, fabric, and puddles>. A locked-off eye-level medium two-shot frames <Subject1> at frame left and <Subject2> at frame right in <Scene1>, standing face-to-face only a short distance apart with rain pouring vertically between them and water streaming down their soaked hair and robes. <Subject1> holds his silver-hilted jian vertically in front of his torso with both hands, the blade pointing upward and rain sheeting along its polished edge, while <Subject2> grips his dark-hilted dao with the blade angled diagonally down toward the wet ground at his side, droplets running off the tip to strike the puddled earth; bamboo leaves tremble under the downpour on both sides of the frame, and the two men hold rigid combat stances with their shoulders squared and gazes locked on each other, neither blinking as the camera begins a very slow, almost imperceptible push-in.

At 4.0 seconds, [the fast drum-and-erhu score continues, the erhu line tightening higher as tension mounts]. <rain continues to hammer the grove, and wet bamboo leaves rustle and sway under the downpour>. The camera begins a smooth slow orbit around the pair, arcing from the frontal two-shot toward <Subject1>'s right side while keeping both swordsmen centered in a medium shot; bamboo stalks and dripping leaves slide past the foreground on both sides, and the rain streaks diagonally across the lens as the move progresses. Both <Subject1> and <Subject2> turn their heads minutely to maintain unbroken eye contact, their sharp gazes following each other across the shifting angle, water dripping from their chins and the edges of their sleeves; <Subject1>'s jaw tightens, and in a cold, low, steady adult male voice he says {你看起来还是一如既往的弱啊。}, his lips barely moving as the words cut through the rain; finally the orbit settles into a three-quarter view that holds both fighters in profile against the curtain of falling water.

At 8.0 seconds, [the drum pattern accelerates into rapid rolling strikes and the erhu surges into a higher, more aggressive line as the duel breaks open]. <rain continues to pour, now joined by sharp metallic clashes and the heavy splash of boots in mud and puddles>. Without a cut, the same continuous camera follows the action as <Subject1> launches the first attack: he steps forward with his front foot splashing through a puddle and drives his jian straight toward <Subject2>'s chest in a direct thrust, the wet blade cutting a silver line through the rain. <Subject2> twists his torso sharply to the side to evade, water flinging from his long black hair and sleeve, and answers with a reverse-grip horizontal sweep of his dao aimed at <Subject1>'s waist; <Subject1> brings his jian vertically downward to block, the two blades meeting with a bright metallic crack that throws a spray of raindrops outward, then immediately rotates his wrists and converts the block into a heavy downward cleave toward <Subject2>'s shoulder. <Subject2> pushes off the wet ground and leaps backward, both boots clearing a puddle that splashes upward beneath him, and lands several paces away with his dao held low; the two exchange a rapid flurry of thrusts, parries, and circular sweeps, their blades weaving intersecting arcs of reflected steel as rain is sliced into fine mist around them, and <Subject1> finishes the sequence with an upward lifting flick of his jian that forces <Subject2> another step back, mud dragging under his retreating boot. <Subject2>'s expression hardens into a snarl, and in a deep, shouting adult male voice he roars {那你猜猜今天究竟鹿死谁手！}; he then surges forward, boots pounding through the puddled earth, and brings his dao down in a powerful overhead cleave. <Subject1> raises his jian to meet it, and the two blades collide violently in the air between them at chest height, the impact sending a visible shockwave that splits the curtain of falling rain outward in a radial burst, water droplets spraying in all directions while both men press their weight against the crossed blades, faces set and rain streaming down their locked stares; finally the frame holds on the crossed swords at the center of the bamboo grove, rain continuing to pour over the two straining figures as the drums and erhu drive to their peak.

# Style and Tone
A sci-fi virtual-reality journey blending live-action performance with CGI environments, rendered with high-contrast cool palettes in the cockpit and vivid, saturated colours in space, the voxel world, and the final planet, carrying a sense of wonder and accelerating immersion in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young man in <Image1>. A young man in his 20s with light skin, short curly dark-brown hair, faint stubble, and dark brown eyes; he wears a black shirt and, once the transition begins, a sleek virtual sci-fi visor with a thin glowing frame that covers his eyes; his voice is not used in this clip.
<Subject2>: References the green voxel flying dragon in <Image3>. A green blocky voxel dragon with a long segmented tail, outstretched blocky wings, an orange eye, and a red open mouth, built entirely from cubic pixels.
<Scene1>: References the spacecraft cockpit interior in <Image1>. A cramped spacecraft cockpit interior with dark metal bulkheads, coiled ribbed hoses, worn silver switch panels holding a black knob, a lit red indicator, and a lit yellow-green indicator, plus a bright rectangular overhead light; cool blue-green lighting, deep shadows, and a muted desaturated grade dominate the space.
<Scene2>: References the deep blue outer space with planets and asteroids in <Image2>. Deep blue outer space filled with distant stars, wispy cyan nebula clouds, scattered irregular asteroids of varying sizes, several planets including a large Earth-like world and a smaller pale world, and a brilliant central blue-white light source emitting sharp rays and lens flares; the grade is richly saturated with deep blues and bright highlights.

Outer space around a large light-green textured planet whose surface shows swirling green and pale land/cloud patterns, a glowing jagged blue lightning-like crack running vertically across its visible hemisphere, dark nebulous clouds on the left, warm golden-yellow nebula glow on the right, a bright blue energy beam entering from the left, and sparse stars across deep black; the grade mixes dark shadows with warm gold and cool blue highlights.

# Summary
References the young man in <Image1> as <Subject1> (man). References the green voxel flying dragon from <Image3> for <Subject2> (dragon). References the spacecraft cockpit interior in <Image1> as <Scene1> (cockpit). References the deep blue outer space with planets and asteroids in <Image2> as <Scene2> (space). References the voxel mountain landscape with sea and sky in <Image3> as <Scene3> (voxel world). References the cracked light-green textured planet in space in <Image4> as <Scene4> (green planet). Inside a spacecraft cockpit, <Subject1> (man) dons a sci-fi visor and the camera orbits closer until it merges with his first-person view, travelling through the visor into deep blue space <Scene2> (space), following ships past asteroids into a blocky voxel landscape <Scene3> (voxel world) where trees audibly grow and a voxel dragon flies overhead, then rushing upward to skim across the cracked light-green planet <Scene4> (green planet).

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, The clip opens on a tight close-up of <Subject1> (man) at frame right inside <Scene1> (cockpit), his face lit by cool blue-green instrument glow as he looks intently toward frame left with a tense, slightly open mouth; the worn silver control panel with its lit red and yellow-green indicators sits at frame left and ribbed hoses recede behind him. The camera begins a slow orbital move around him from a third-person distance, arcing from his left side toward his front while gradually pushing closer. <Subject1> (man) raises his right hand from below frame and brings a sleek virtual sci-fi visor up to his face, settling it over his eyes so its thin frame glows faintly against his skin; his brow tightens as the visor activates. <low cockpit hum, faint electronic whine as the visor powers on>

3.0–6.0 seconds, The orbit tightens into a near close-up and the camera pushes straight into <Subject1> (man)'s visor, the cockpit lights and panel blurring into streaks of blue and white as the third-person view dissolves into his subjective perspective; a brief digital tunnelling effect of light trails rushes forward. The view resolves into <Scene2> (space): deep blue cosmos dotted with stars, drifting asteroids of irregular jagged shapes, and several planets hanging in the distance, with a brilliant blue-white central starburst flaring ahead. Several sleek spacecraft appear in the foreground, their engines glowing blue as they streak away from the camera toward the bright light; the camera accelerates to follow directly behind them, weaving between tumbling asteroids while lens flares bloom across the frame. <whoosh of thrusters, distant resonant space hum, faint asteroid debris scraping past>

6.0–10.5 seconds, Still moving at speed behind the ships, the blue starburst ahead pixelates into bright cubic blocks and the deep space vista reshapes itself into <Scene3> (voxel world): the camera bursts through a bright sky of floating white cube clouds and drops into a low-altitude flight over rolling green block-grass hills, a blue inland lake sliding past on frame left and the deep-blue ocean glinting on frame right. The camera skims low over the terrain toward the tall grey block-stone mountain crowned with a blue cubic structure and antenna; as it passes terraced slopes, blocky trees visibly grow upward from the grass in quick successive bursts, cubes stacking to form trunks and canopies. At frame right, <Subject2> (dragon) flies in the sky above the mountain, wings spread block by block as it banks in the same direction as the camera. The camera tilts upward while still moving forward, aiming at the sky above the mountain peak. <soft crisp sounds of tiny blocks clicking and stacking as vegetation grows, wind rushing past, distant blocky ambient chirps>

10.5–13.0 seconds, From the low voxel terrain the camera tilts fully up and accelerates vertically in a rapid rush; the blocky sky stretches into motion-blurred streaks of blue and white that collapse back into star-filled blackness, revealing <Scene4> (green planet) ahead: a large light-green textured world with swirling surface patterns, a jagged glowing blue crack running down its visible face, dark nebula on the left and warm golden-yellow nebula on the right, with a bright blue energy beam slicing in from frame left. The camera hurtles straight toward the planet, the globe swelling rapidly to fill the frame as stars and nebulous clouds stream past at the edges. <intensifying whoosh of high-speed travel, low building cosmic drone>

13.0–16.0 seconds, The camera reaches the light-green planet and skims across its surface at speed, flying just above the swirling green and pale textured terrain; the glowing blue crack flashes brightly beneath as the viewpoint races along the curve of the globe, with dark space and golden nebula glow sliding past at the upper edge of frame. The trajectory continues to arc along the planet's limb, the surface textures rushing by in a blur of green, white, and electric blue until the clip ends mid-flight over the world. <roaring atmospheric rush, deep resonant planetary hum, crackle of blue energy from the surface fissure>

cases.title: 四季场景步行
cases.prompt: Using the attached character as the subject, generate a continuous walking sequence where the environment transitions seamlessly every 3 seconds: 0–3s desert dunes at sunset, 3–6s neon-soaked rainy city street, 6–9s misty alpine forest, 9–12s clean white infinity studio. Character stride, outfit, and proportions remain identical throughout. Camera tracks alongside in profile, locked focal length, 12 seconds, 16:9.
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A cinematic live-action fashion walk sequence with seamless environmental transitions, polished high-fashion lighting per environment, a cool-to-warm tonal range across scenes, and a steady, confident mood in 16:9 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the young woman in western-style attire in <Image1>, but not the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image1>. A young woman in her early twenties with fair skin, defined cheekbones, light blue eyes, neutral lips, and long wavy brown hair; wearing a black wide-brimmed cowboy hat, a high-neck blouse with a white ruffled floral collar and a black-white-orange plaid pattern with oversized balloon sleeves, bright turquoise high-waisted wide-leg trousers, a black leather belt with a silver buckle and a brown leather keeper, and thin hanging chains at each cuff; her proportions, outfit, and stride stay consistent throughout.

<Scene1>: References the desert dunes at sunset in <Image2>. A desert dune landscape at golden sunset, with rippled warm amber sand in the foreground, a small dark-green desert bush on the right dune, rocky dark mountains rising in the midground left, distant mountain ranges across the horizon, a low glowing sun on the right casting long rays, and a sky of scattered clouds tinted orange and gold; warm golden-orange colour grade with soft directional sunlight.

<Scene2>: References the neon-soaked rainy city street in <Image3>. A neon-lit rainy city street at night, with wet black asphalt reflecting pink, blue, magenta and red neon, a red vertical "DINER" sign and cursive "The Diner" neon on the left brick building, a blue-outlined "RAIN MOTEL" sign with "VACANCY KITCHENETTES" on the right, a "West 39th St" street sign, a "ONE WAY" sign, pink steam rising in the mid-distance, tall dark skyscrapers with lit windows, streetlights, traffic lights, and falling rain; deep blue-purple colour grade with high-contrast neon highlights and glossy reflections.

<Scene3>: References the misty alpine forest trail in <Image4>. A misty alpine forest with a narrow brown dirt trail winding between tall straight evergreen trunks, moss-covered rocks and fallen logs on both sides, green ferns and low undergrowth, dense fog softening the background trees into silhouettes, and damp earth under diffused overcast light; cool desaturated green-grey colour grade with soft diffused lighting and visible atmospheric haze.

<Scene4>: References the clean white infinity studio in <Image5>. A clean white infinity studio with seamless white floor, walls and back wall meeting in sharp corners, four recessed circular ceiling lights (two near the left wall, two near the right wall) casting even soft illumination, and no props or decoration; bright neutral white colour grade with flat, shadowless studio lighting.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the young woman in western-style attire in <Image1> as <Subject1> (woman); does not take the plain grey studio backdrop of <Image1>. References the desert dunes at sunset in <Image2> as <Scene1> (desert dunes). References the neon-soaked rainy city street in <Image3> as <Scene2> (neon rainy city street). References the misty alpine forest trail in <Image4> as <Scene3> (misty alpine forest). References the clean white infinity studio in <Image5> as <Scene4> (white infinity studio). <Subject1> (woman) walks in a steady profile stride as the background seamlessly morphs from desert dunes at sunset to a neon rainy city street, then to a misty alpine forest, and finally to a clean white infinity studio, while her outfit, proportions and walking motion remain unchanged and the camera tracks alongside at a locked focal length.

# Complete Description
0.0–3.0 seconds, A medium-long profile shot, camera at chest height, locked focal length, tracking smoothly alongside <Subject1> (woman) as she walks from frame right toward frame left at a steady, even stride, her arms swinging naturally by her sides in rhythm with her steps. <Scene1> (desert dunes) fills the entire background: golden rippled sand stretches across the ground, the desert bush sits on the right dune, dark rocky mountains rise on the left horizon, the low sun glows on the right, and scattered sunset clouds drift slowly; warm sunset light rakes across <Subject1> (woman), matching the desert palette while her outfit, proportions and hat remain exactly as established. <wind softly stirring sand> [a slow, warm atmospheric synth pad begins] As the 3.0 second mark approaches, the sand, mountains and sky begin to dissolve smoothly into the next environment without a cut, <Subject1> (woman)'s stride uninterrupted.

3.0–6.0 seconds, The shot size, angle, focal length and tracking speed remain unchanged as the background completes its seamless transition into <Scene2> (neon rainy city street): wet reflective asphalt now lies under <Subject1> (woman)'s feet, neon signs ("DINER", "The Diner", "RAIN MOTEL", "West 39th St") glow on either side, pink steam rises down the street, tall dark buildings line the road, and rain falls visibly around her. <Subject1> (woman) continues the same steady profile walk, her sleeves and trouser hems moving identically, the neon pink and blue light now colouring her silhouette while her outfit and proportions stay unchanged. <rain pattering on pavement, distant city hum> [the warm synth pad shifts into a darker, pulsing synthwave beat with a slow bassline] Toward 6.0 seconds, the neon lights, wet street and rain begin to blur and blend into the next environment in a continuous dissolve, her walking motion never breaking.

6.0–9.0 seconds, Camera continues tracking at the same locked focal length and distance as the transition resolves into <Scene3> (misty alpine forest): the dirt trail now runs beneath <Subject1> (woman), tall mossy evergreen trunks line both sides, ferns and fallen logs cover the banks, and thick fog drifts between the receding trees. <Subject1> (woman) maintains her identical profile stride, arm swing and posture, with the same hat, plaid blouse, turquoise trousers and belt, now lit by cool diffused forest light; a faint mist passes in front of her without altering her silhouette. <soft forest breeze, distant bird call> [the synthwave beat fades into a quiet, airy ambient texture with sustained strings] As 9.0 seconds nears, the trees, moss and fog wash smoothly into bright white, again without a cut or change in her walk.

9.0–12.0 seconds, The tracking shot, focal length and <Subject1> (woman)'s stride, outfit and proportions remain perfectly consistent as the environment settles into <Scene4> (white infinity studio): seamless white floor and walls surround her, four recessed ceiling lights cast even soft illumination, and no other objects are present. <Subject1> (woman) continues walking in profile at the same pace across the clean white space, the studio light rendering her colours true and her silhouette crisp. <subtle studio ambience> [the airy ambient texture resolves into a clean, held single tone that fades gently] The shot holds to the end with <Subject1> (woman) still mid-stride, background fully white, movement smooth and continuous to 12.0 seconds.

cases.title: 人机剑斗快切甩镜
cases.prompt:
主战场是图2里的一片狭窄泥路空地。
图1中男主从画面一侧高速冲入战场，机械人从正前方迎击。
两人始终在同一片长着高草的空地中缠斗，机械人与男主真人大小一致。
男主使用长剑，机械人也使用真实的金属长剑，剑保持原样，呈暗淡的金属光泽，没有发光效果、没有能量特效、没有额外特效。
战斗节奏必须极快，通过快切、甩镜、前景遮挡、蒙太奇的方式，呈现“乱而有章法、看不清完整动作”的高光剑影感。

镜头1｜0.0s—2.0s
开场侧面冲刺拔剑

侧面机位，中景跟拍，机位位于男主左侧。
男主沿着狭窄泥路在高草中高速冲刺，衣摆、斗笠和发丝被暴雨打得凌乱飞动，脚步踩进泥水不断溅起水花。镜头与男主同向高速移动跟拍。
冲刺过程中男主右手瞬间握住剑柄，在奔跑中快速拔出长剑，动作极短、极狠、极快，没有预备姿势，没有停顿。拔剑瞬间只看到一抹冷暗的剑光掠过，动作要有真实的惯性与力量感，类似老港片武侠作品里边冲边出剑的高能开场。
结尾让镜头捕捉到男主拔剑后继续冲向前方敌人的状态。

镜头2｜2.0s—4.0s
正面对冲，第一轮试探交锋

与镜头1不同，切到男主正前方偏右的低角度机位。
机械人从前方的雨雾和高草中迎面逼近，真实机械质感强烈，动作充满压迫感、稳定、杀气极重。男主冲到近前的瞬间，机械人毫无停顿，直接一记力量极大的斜劈砍下。
男主以极快的身法侧闪避开，同时长剑顺势贴着机械人躯干掠过，砍在机械人的金属身体上，发出沉闷的反弹声与类似火花的金属擦撞感，但不要夸张特效，只需呈现真实的金属反弹效果。
这一镜要突出：

机械人的攻击重、狠、致命
男主的闪避快、灵、贴身
男主砍中机械人身体后有明显的反弹感，不是轻飘飘划过

镜头3｜4.0s—7.0s
蒙太奇快切，机械人疯狂无脑压迫砍杀，男主贴身穿梭闪避反击

这一段采用多机位蒙太奇快切，但每个切镜都只保留极短的高光动作，不要拖沓。

机位A：微俯拍全景
从上方斜俯拍两人的战斗轨迹，机械人像一台只会压迫式疯砍的机器般连续追杀，左右横扫、上劈、反劈、贴身追砍，不搞花架子，只追求致命压迫感。男主围绕机械人身体快速变向，如同在机械人身边游走。

机位B：近距离侧后方手持
镜头贴近机械人肩后，拍到机械人一剑接一剑地重砍，男主在极近距离下低头、沉肩、转胯、滑步，从剑锋边缘连续擦身闪过。

机位C：低角度近景
男主贴地滑步，机械人的剑锋从头顶和肩侧掠过，雨水被剑风切开。男主趁躲闪的间隙，快速一剑砍向机械人的肋侧、腰侧、手臂关节，剑砍在机械金属躯体上，呈现出真实硬碰硬的震手反弹感。

机位D：超近特写蒙太奇

剑锋擦过机械人金属外壳
机械人手臂发力挥剑
男主鞋底踩进泥水急停变向
雨珠、泥点、衣摆、剑身快速甩动
男主与机械人一触即分的擦身瞬间

这一整段的观感必须是：
机械人疯狂致命地乱砍，男主快到几乎看不清动作，在机械人身边不停躲闪和削砍，画面乱而有章法，快而不虚假。

镜头4｜7.0s—10.0s
机械人重击震飞男主

切到全新的侧面大动态机位，不重复前面的视角。
侧面拍摄两人中距离缠斗，机械人突然抓住节奏，单手或双手蓄力一记极重的横劈或斜劈砍向男主。男主举剑格挡，下一瞬就被那股巨大的冲击力直接震飞出去。
动作重点：

机械人这一劈像重锤一般，力道极大
男主不是自己跳开，而是被明显“震飞”
身体腾空后摔落地面，落地要有真实的翻滚和泥水冲击感
剑、身体、衣摆、泥水都要有真实惯性
这一镜要明确打出“机械人力量压制”的压迫感。

镜头5｜10.0s—15.0s
高能收尾：空中插剑—地面躲避—胯下滑出—对峙站起

这一段必须一气呵成，快速、紧张、刺激，不要拖沓。

动作核心要求
机械人
机械人必须是与真人同比例大小的真实机械改造人
不是巨大怪物，不是机甲
每一剑都像是要人命的疯砍，压迫感极强
攻击逻辑是无脑压迫、连续致命砍杀、力量极大
剑保持原样，呈暗淡金属质感，无发光无特效

男主
男主速度必须快到看不清完整动作
主要依靠灵活身法：侧闪、沉肩、转胯、滑步、低头、贴身换位、擦身反击
砍中机械人身体时，要有真实的反弹效果
轻功动作必须有真实的腾空、落地、蹬地、翻身、滑行、起身的物理感
结尾“被震飞—躲插剑—胯下滑出—身后站起”必须一气呵成

风格统一要求
整个环境必须是枯草丛生而且长得很高
画面充满江湖意境，如同雨夜荒野中的武侠决斗
参考《倩女幽魂》的阴冷、潮湿、荒凉、神秘气质
全片无慢镜头
全片通过快切、甩镜、前景遮挡、蒙太奇强化战斗高光
观感是：快、狠、乱、真、刺激、刀光剑影、看不清却招招到位
cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A live-action wuxia duel rendered in cold, desaturated, rain-soaked tones, combining gritty realism with rapid Hong Kong-style swordplay montage, handheld kinetic camera work, and a 9:16 framing that emphasizes claustrophobic, high-tension close combat.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the wandering swordsman in <Image1>, but not its plain grey studio backdrop. An East Asian man in his thirties with weathered, grimy skin, a sharp jaw, thick dark brows, deep-set eyes, a thin mustache and a small goatee; long, messy black hair falls in damp strands around his face. He wears a tattered dark brown woven straw hat, layered ragged robes in faded grey and black with frayed hems, a dark sash at the waist, wrapped lower legs, and worn dark cloth boots. He carries a long straight sword in a dark scabbard with a wrapped grip; the blade has a dull dark steel finish with no glow. His voice and demeanor are silent and focused.
<Subject2>: References the cyborg swordsman in <Image3>, but not its glowing blue energy sword or plain grey studio backdrop. A human-sized cyborg swordsman with a polished dark navy and brushed bronze mechanical body, a featureless angular metallic face mask, exposed mechanical joints at the neck, elbows, wrists, and knees, a dark topknot held by a mechanical hairpiece with hanging pins, segmented navy armor plates with silver trim, a high standing collar, a long armored skirt with layered plates, thick corded cables at the waist, and bronze-and-dark-blue mechanical hands and feet. He wields a long real-metal longsword with a dull non-glowing metallic blade and a wrapped hilt.
<Scene1>: References the rainy marshland path with a thatched hut in <Image2>. A narrow muddy path cutting through tall, dry brown reeds and marsh grass, with a small weathered thatched hut on wooden posts to one side, dark forested mountains rising behind drifting fog and heavy rain; the palette is cold desaturated green-grey, with dim diffused storm light, wet surfaces, constant vertical rain streaks, and deep mist obscuring the distance.

# Overlays
None.

# Summary
References the wandering swordsman in <Image1> as <Subject1> (swordsman). References the cyborg swordsman in <Image3> as <Subject2> (cyborg). References the rainy marshland path with a thatched hut in <Image2> as <Scene1> (marshland path). In a storm-lashed marshland path, <Subject1> (swordsman) charges and duels the relentlessly attacking <Subject2> (cyborg) with blindingly fast close-quarters swordplay, is struck and knocked back by a heavy blow, then evades a plunging strike, slides beneath the opponent, and rises behind <Subject2> (cyborg) to face him in a tense standoff.

# Complete Description
0.0–2.0 seconds, The shot opens in a side medium tracking shot positioned to <Subject1> (swordsman)'s left, moving forward at high speed down the muddy path of <Scene1> (marshland path). <Subject1> (swordsman) sprints through the tall reeds at frame centre, his tattered robes, straw hat, and loose hair whipping violently under heavy rain; his boots hammer into the mud, splashing dark water upward with every stride. His right hand snaps to the hilt of his sword and, mid-sprint without any preparatory pause, he rips the long blade free in one short, brutal motion; a single glint of dull steel flashes across the frame as the blade clears the scabbard. Rain streaks diagonally across the lens, foreground reeds whip past to create partial obstructions, and the camera keeps pace with him as he continues driving forward toward the unseen enemy ahead. <heavy rain drumming on reeds and mud, cloth snapping in wind, the sharp metallic ring of a sword being drawn>

2.0–4.0 seconds, The shot cuts abruptly to a low-angle front-three-quarter view from <Subject1> (swordsman)'s front-right, the camera planted low on the mud. Through sheets of rain and swaying tall grass at frame centre, <Subject2> (cyborg) advances with heavy, steady, menacing steps, his mechanical joints glistening wet, sword held ready in a low guard. As <Subject1> (swordsman) closes the distance at full sprint, <Subject2> (cyborg) unleashes a powerful downward diagonal slash without hesitation, the blade cutting rain as it arcs. <Subject1> (swordsman) twists his body sharply, dropping his shoulder and sliding his lead foot to flash past the strike at close range, then drives his own dull steel blade horizontally across <Subject2> (cyborg)'s armored torso; the sword bites with a heavy metallic rebound, throwing a brief, sparse shower of real metal sparks and a visible jolt up <Subject1> (swordsman)'s arms before the two spring apart a half-step. <thudding mechanical footfalls in mud, a heavy whoosh of blade displacing rain, a loud dull clang of steel on armor, brief metallic scrape, rain hissing>

4.0–7.0 seconds, A rapid-fire montage of extremely short cuts begins, each shot lasting only a fraction of a second and linked by hard whip-pans and foreground reed occlusions. From a slightly high angled wide view above the path, <Subject2> (cyborg) presses forward relentlessly, delivering continuous horizontal sweeps, overhead chops, reverse-angle slashes, and close-range pursuit cuts with no flourish, while <Subject1> (swordsman) circles and changes direction around him in tight arcs through the mud. A close handheld shot from over <Subject2> (cyborg)'s rear shoulder shows one heavy swing after another hammering past inches from <Subject1> (swordsman), who ducks his head, drops his weight, rotates his hips, and glides his feet to slip just beyond each blade edge. A low-angle close shot catches <Subject1> (swordsman) sliding low on the wet ground as <Subject2> (cyborg)'s sword shears rain just above his scalp and beside his shoulder, then snapping quick counter-cuts into <Subject2> (cyborg)'s ribs, waist, and arm joints, each impact producing a hard metallic jolt and small real sparks. Extreme close-ups flash in quick succession: a dull blade edge scraping across dark armor plate, a mechanical forearm tensing and rotating as it swings, <Subject1> (swordsman)'s muddy boot sole stamping into a puddle to reverse direction, raindrops and mud flecks exploding off swinging cloth and steel, and the two fighters brushing past each other shoulder-to-shoulder before separating. <rapid overlapping clangs and scrapes of steel on metal, squelching mud under quick feet, heavy blade whooshes cutting rain, cloth and straw hat flapping, continuous drumming rain>

7.0–10.0 seconds, The montage cuts to a new dynamic side angle, framing the two fighters at mid-distance along the path of <Scene1> (marshland path). <Subject2> (cyborg) suddenly plants his lead foot, winds up with both hands on his sword hilt, and unleashes a devastating horizontal-to-diagonal cleave with enormous force. <Subject1> (swordsman) raises his long sword in a two-handed block to meet the strike; the moment the blades collide, the impact visibly hammers through his arms and body, lifting him off his feet and hurling him backward through the rain. He tumbles through the air, robes and hat trailing, and crashes into the muddy path several paces away, rolling hard across the wet ground in a spray of dark water and loose reeds, his sword still gripped in his hand as mud and rainwater splash around him. <a thunderous metallic impact, a sharp grunt of exertion, body slamming into wet mud, splashing water, rain continuing to hammer down>

cases.title: 爆炸子弹时间
cases.prompt: 身后烈焰接连爆炸，低沉而厚重的爆破轰鸣向外扩散，伴随着冲击波撕裂空气的震动声。时间骤然放缓，子弹时间效果启动，爆炸声被强行拉长并压低，化为低频震颤，玻璃碎片碎裂的清脆声、瓦砾崩解的咔裂声与火焰燃烧的呼啸声在空中被分层定格。摄像机开始以完整的360度缓慢环绕特工旋转，环境音几乎冻结，只剩下子弹出膛的尖锐破空声被延展成锋利的残响，弹壳在半空中发出轻微金属旋转声。车辆在空中翻转时传来沉闷的结构扭曲声，火焰与火花停滞于动态之中，燃烧声化为持续的低频背景。整体氛围爆发而超现实，音效与画面共同营造出致敬高端动作电影的极致瞬间，充满力量、压迫感与视觉冲击力。

# Style and Tone
The nautical sailing cinematic live-action short video carries a bright, clear, brisk daytime atmosphere with a pervading sense of open-sea readiness.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A young adult male crew member in his late twenties with an athletic build, short tousled light brown hair, short brown stubble along the jaw, and fair skin visible at the neck and ear; he wears a navy blue hooded sweatshirt with the hood resting at his back, and is seen from behind in an over-the-shoulder composition.
<Subject2>: A middle-aged male skipper in his fifties with a stocky build, short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard, and dark sunglasses; he wears a navy blue fleece jacket over a light blue collared shirt, khaki trousers, and a small white emblem on the left chest of his jacket.
<Subject3>: A large white mainsail made of heavy woven sailcloth with curved stitched seams, a reinforced grey leech tape, and a stainless steel ring cringle at its lower corner; at the opening it lies loosely folded in thick rumpled piles across the deck, with only its leading edge partially raised along the mast track.
<Subject4>: A white-and-red flecked mooring-and-sheet rope with a braided synthetic texture, running from <Subject1>'s hands forward through a polished stainless steel deck block and clipping to the cringle at <Subject3>'s lower corner.
<Scene1>: The teak side deck of a modern sailing yacht under a clear pale blue sky with thin wispy clouds, on a calm open blue sea with small rolling swells. The deck is laid with narrow light brown teak planks separated by thin black caulking lines and edged with a white fibreglass toerail and polished stainless steel stanchions supporting thin wire lifelines; a large varnished wooden spoked helm wheel, a white binnacle housing the compass, a black sheet winch, and a folded navy blue sail cover lashed along the boom sit at the raised stern cockpit. Bright midday sunlight falls from high overhead, casting sharp short shadows across the planks and the folded sailcloth.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On the calm open sea aboard the sailing yacht <Scene1>, the young crewman <Subject1> hauls the sheet rope <Subject4> through the deck block while the skipper <Subject2> calls directions from the helm, until the folded white mainsail <Subject3> snaps taut and fills with wind as the boat holds its course.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <soft lapping of small waves against the white hull and a light onshore breeze> establish the sound bed. A locked-off over-the-shoulder medium shot frames <Scene1> from behind <Subject1> in the immediate left foreground: his navy hooded back and the back of his brown-haired head fill the lower left, his right hand grips <Subject4> ahead of his body and his left hand grips the rope closer to his torso, the braided white-and-red line running forward along the teak planks, through the polished stainless steel deck block set on the deck at mid-foreground, and onward to the stainless cringle at the lower corner of <Subject3>. The white mainsail lies in thick rumpled folds across the center and right of the deck, its stitched seams and grey edge tape catching the sun, while at the distant stern <Subject2> stands behind the large wooden helm wheel with his left hand resting on a spoke and his right arm raised, index finger pointing directly toward <Subject1>, mouth open as he shouts directions <a faint, wind-carried male shout from the stern, crisp rope friction as the line shifts in the block>. The focus rests on <Subject2> at the helm while <Subject1>'s shoulder and the folded sailcloth remain readable in the foreground and midground, preserving the clear depth between near hands, mid-deck sail, and far helmsman. <Subject1> immediately begins hauling: his right arm pulls back toward his hip, his left hand slides forward along the rope, then grips and pulls in turn, the line running in short firm tugs through the block <repeated crisp rope-on-metal friction sounds>; the cringle at the sail's corner draws a little closer along the deck, and the nearest folds of <Subject3> shift and slide across the teak planks as tension builds.

At 4.8 seconds, <the soft wave lap and rope friction continue under the skipper's continuing shouts>. The camera remains in the same over-the-shoulder position with a very slow push-in, keeping <Subject1>'s shoulder anchored at the lower left while the deck block and the rope's angle grow slightly larger in frame. <Subject1> leans his weight back, both hands pulling <Subject4> in longer, steadier draws; the line straightens between his hands and the block, lifting a short section clear of the planks, and the stainless cringle at <Subject3>'s corner is pulled steadily forward and upward along the deck, dragging the nearest layers of folded sailcloth with it so that deep creases flatten and new folds ripple outward across the white fabric. At the stern, <Subject2> keeps his left hand on the helm wheel, his right arm still raised and pointing, head turned to watch the sail as his mouth continues to move in shouted direction; the boat holds a steady heading across the calm blue sea, thin high clouds drifting slowly in the pale sky and the stanchion wires trembling faintly in the breeze.

At 9.0 seconds, <the wave lap and rope friction swell beneath a building rush of wind>. The same over-the-shoulder framing holds as <Subject1> gives one final strong backward pull on <Subject4>, both arms drawing the rope tight against his hip; the line snaps taut through the deck block with a sharp report, and the lower corner of <Subject3> is hauled up and out until the nearest edge of the sail lifts clear of the deck. Wind catches the suddenly exposed cloth, billowing the white fabric upward in a rapid unfolding wave that runs from the cringle toward the mast, the heavy folds lifting, shaking free of one another, and ballooning into a curved filled shape <a deep, resonant canvas boom as the sail fills, followed by sustained cloth flutter and rigging hum>. The remaining loose sailcloth slides across the teak planks and then rises off them, leaving only a few flattened wrinkles near the block, while the stainless cringle holds fast at the rope's end and the line now angles tautly upward from the block to the filled sail corner. At the stern, <Subject2> lowers his pointing arm and grips the helm wheel with both hands, bracing his feet as the boat heels a small amount under the newly filled sail, his mouth closing as he watches the set of the canvas; finally the frame holds on the over-the-shoulder view of the now-filled white mainsail drawing steadily above the sunlit teak deck, with <Subject1> still holding the trimmed rope in both hands and <Subject2> steady at the helm while the calm sea and bright sky stretch out beyond the stern.

A first-person point-of-view low-angle shot, held from the rider's own eye line with the camera tilted slightly downward, frames <Subject1> descending <Scene1>: the rounded black nose of the snowboard points straight down the fall line at the lower center of the frame, the rider's black snow pants and black boot occupy the lower foreground, bright white powder explodes outward from both edges of the board in thick plumes and scattered airborne flakes, and a narrow carved track runs straight ahead between steep snow-covered mountain walls toward jagged distant peaks under a pale overcast sky. At 2.6 seconds, <the snow-cutting hiss and wind roar drop to a distant, airy whoosh>. A hard cut jumps to a high aerial wide shot looking down the length of <Scene2>, the camera positioned high above the slope and slowly pushing forward; the vast white snowfield fills the frame between two converging snow-capped ridges, and <Subject2> appears as a small black dot near the upper center of the slope, already moving. The tiny figure carves a long, clean S-shaped track into the untouched white surface, the dark line sweeping first toward frame left then arcing back toward frame right in a continuous serpentine curve as the rider's body tilts into each turn; fresh spray fans out from each edge change as a faint white plume against the snow, and the carved S-trail lengthens behind the figure while the surrounding mountain walls and distant peaks remain still in the background; finally the small dark rider completes the second arc of the S and continues down the fall line toward the lower section of the slope.

At 5.4 seconds, <the wind and snow-hiss return to full volume as the perspective drops back to rider level>. A hard cut returns to a forward-tracking first-person shot now in <Scene3>: red and blue slalom gate flags flash past on both sides of the frame in quick succession as <Subject1> threads between them, the black snowboard nose cutting tight alternating lines through the course and powder spraying outward with each edge change. At 8.0 seconds, <the snow-cutting hiss and wind roar surge back at full intensity, joined by the sound of the board base hissing faster over firm snow>. The same first-person forward shot holds as <Subject1> accelerates straight down the final pitch of <Scene3>, the black snowboard nose centered in the lower frame and powder streaming off both edges in long white tails; the horizontal finish banner stretches across the run directly ahead, with indistinct spectator figures gathered beyond it. # Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a slow, spacious ambient pad with high crystalline overtones begins]. A locked-off macro close-up frames <Subject1> resting in the central fabric depression of <Scene1>, its brushed outer band angled so the top facet faces the upper right and the glowing green inner channel faces the camera; volumetric light beams slant from the upper left through faint dust motes, the silk folds curve away into soft blur at the edges, and the ring casts a faint green reflection onto the weave beneath it. Hovering a few inches above the ring's center, <Subject2> hangs as a perfectly spherical mirror-silver bead catching the cool light, then begins a slow downward drift in slow motion, its surface distorting only minutely as it falls while the camera holds the ring centered and tracks the droplet's descent with a subtle forward push; <a soft, low liquid hum builds beneath the ambient pad, joined by the faint rustle of silk>. The droplet elongates slightly into a teardrop as it nears the brushed titanium, makes contact with the top facet of the band without any splash, and immediately flattens into a spreading silver film that wets the grain and flows seamlessly into the metal rather than beading or bouncing; <a soft wet merging sound, a sustained high crystalline chime, and the first low, steady heartbeat thud arrive together>. As the liquid metal vanishes into the surface, the row of emerald LED dots inside the inner channel brightens sharply, their glow intensifying from a dim line to a vivid luminous band that washes the polished inner walls with green light; finally the brightened glow holds across the full inner circumference while the outer band shows no seam or residue where the droplet merged.

At 3.4 seconds, [the spacious ambient pad continues beneath the rhythmic pulse]. The same macro shot tilts slightly and racks focus downward to follow the light as it travels: the intensified emerald glow spills from the inner channel over the polished beveled edges, races as a luminous wave along the fine brushed grain of the outer band, and slips down the ring's lower curve to the point where the metal touches the silk; <the high crystalline chime sustains and softens, while steady heartbeat thuds continue at a calm resting pace and the silk rustle grows more present>. Where the green light meets the fabric, a bio-luminescent pattern blooms outward from beneath the ring in time with each heartbeat: a soft emerald flush spreads through the weave along the nearest fold, pulses brighter, then recedes slightly before the next thud pushes it further, the glow tracing the curves of the silk and making the fine woven texture glisten as if lit from within while tiny dust motes catch the green light in the air above. The camera eases into a slightly lower angle to keep both the glowing band and the spreading silk pattern in view, the light pulses continuing at the same unhurried heartbeat rhythm and the silk's luminous patches expanding outward along the creases without disturbing the fabric's draped shape; finally the frame holds on <Subject1> glowing steadily at the center of <Scene1>, its emerald band pulsing in sync with the heartbeat-paced bio-luminescent silk pattern beneath it, the liquid fusion sound faded and the crystalline chime, soft rustle, and rhythmic heartbeat carrying the scene to its close.

# Style and Tone
The surreal urban fantasy cinematic live-action short film, evoking Inception-style impossible architecture, carries a dreamlike, disorienting and awe-struck atmosphere with a pervading sense of unreality.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Adult man in his thirties with a lean build, short neatly combed dark brown hair swept back, light stubble along the jaw, wearing a dark charcoal grey jacket with a turned-up collar; seen from behind in three-quarter back view, head tilted upward.
<Subject2>: Adult woman with long straight dark brown hair falling past her shoulders, seen from behind with only the back of her head and hair visible in the lower foreground.
<Scene1>: A sunlit Parisian street intersection flanked by tall cream-stone Haussmann apartment buildings with black wrought-iron balcony railings, shuttered windows, carved stone cornices, cast-iron drainpipes, shopfronts with maroon and beige awnings including a storefront with red lettering 【BONHEUR】 and a 【PRESSE】 newsstand, dark sedans parked along the asphalt, a small white van further down the slope, and distant pedestrians in light summer clothing; pale blue sky sits above the skyline, warm afternoon daylight casts long soft shadows across the stone facades, and the distant cityscape rises in stacked, receding tiers up a steep hill.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
From a Parisian street intersection <Scene1>, a man <Subject1> and a woman <Subject2> stand with their backs to the camera looking up as the camera pushes forward past their shoulders and the Haussmann facades ahead progressively fold, curl and stack into an impossible, Inception-like inverted city geometry.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <distant Parisian street ambience: soft traffic hum, faint pedestrian footsteps, and a light breeze> fills the air. An eye-level over-the-shoulder wide shot frames <Subject1> at the lower left foreground in three-quarter back view, his head tilted back to look up the street, and <Subject2> centered lower foreground with only the back of her long dark hair visible, both standing on the left sidewalk of <Scene1>; cream-stone Haussmann facades line both sides of the sloping street, black wrought-iron balconies and shuttered windows run up their walls, maroon and beige awnings shade ground-floor shopfronts, dark sedans and a small white van occupy the asphalt, a few pedestrians walk near the intersection, and the stacked cityscape rises tier upon tier up the steep hill toward a pale blue sky. The camera begins a steady forward push past the two figures, keeping them anchored at the lower edge of frame while the street and facades ahead grow larger; distant cars hold their positions, pedestrians continue small walking motions, and warm afternoon light stays consistent across the stone. Around 2.0 seconds the first visible distortion begins at the upper skyline: the farthest tiers of buildings lose their straight vertical alignment, cornice lines tilt, and the stone facades start to bend as if made of flexible paper rather than rigid masonry, while the nearer buildings on the immediate left and right remain upright and the two foreground figures stay still, still looking up.

At 4.2 seconds, <the street ambience drops to a low, resonant rumble beneath the continuing traffic hum>. The same uninterrupted forward push continues, now tightening toward a medium-wide view as the camera glides past <Subject1>'s shoulder and leaves <Subject2> as a dark hair silhouette at the bottom center; the mid-distance facades directly ahead begin the main transformation. Whole stone facades hinge along horizontal lines like folded paper, upper floors curl upward and backward in smooth arcs, mansard roofs tilt over the street, and balconies and window rows bend with the curving stone without breaking apart, while the stacked cityscape beyond rises in impossible inverted tiers that fold over one another so that streets appear to run vertically up folded walls and windows face downward onto the road below. Parked cars in the nearer foreground remain on level asphalt, pedestrians in the distance slow and look upward, and the warm daylight continues to rake across the bending stone, casting curved shadows that follow the new geometry; the camera keeps pushing forward without shake, holding the unfolding architecture centered.

At 7.8 seconds, <the low resonant rumble swells and then settles into a deep sustained drone>. The forward push decelerates and finally comes to a stop in a wide symmetrical view down the transformed street of <Scene1>: the entire block ahead has resolved into an impossible folded cityscape, with Haussmann facades curving upward and overhead in a continuous arc, inverted buildings stacked above the street so that their balconies and shuttered windows hang over the road, the red 【BONHEUR】 storefront and the beige 【PRESSE】 awning still readable on the nearer corners now tilted with the bending stone, and the pale blue sky visible through gaps between the folded tiers. <Subject1> and <Subject2> remain at the near edge of frame with their backs to the camera, heads tilted up at the massive inverted geometry, the nearer parked cars sit undisturbed on the level asphalt, and the final held composition lingers on the dreamlike folded Paris skyline.

cases.caption:
# Style and Tone
A playful marble-run toy showcase short video, photorealistic live-action footage, carries a bright, lively, satisfying atmosphere with a pervading sense of smooth kinetic flow.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A clear glass marble with a polished spherical surface, containing a swirling internal ribbon of deep blue that curves around a bright lime-yellow streak, catching light into sharp star-shaped highlights and casting a refracted caustic on the wood beneath it.
<Scene1>: An elaborate indoor wooden marble-run chain track built from light natural-grain timber, with a long central U-shaped trough running from the foreground toward the background, flanked by raised wooden rails; to the left of the trough sit interlocking bright plastic gears in blue, green, orange and yellow, a tall blue spiked gear wheel, a green base plate, and small yellow and orange plastic components; to the right runs a row of upright black rectangular domino blocks set in a line beside the rail, with additional wooden supports, yellow and blue plastic pieces, and further track sections receding into a softly blurred exhibition-hall background lit by warm overhead spotlights that produce round bokeh highlights.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On the elaborate wooden chain track <Scene1>, the clear blue-and-yellow swirled glass marble <Subject1> rolls rapidly down the central trough in a continuous smooth tracking shot, passing colorful plastic gears and a line of black domino blocks as the camera follows it along the run.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <a low, steady wooden rolling hum fills the track, layered with faint plastic gear clicks from the background>. A low eye-level close shot, locked onto the central trough of <Scene1>, frames <Subject1> resting in the foreground center of the light wooden channel, its blue and yellow internal swirl catching the overhead spotlights and throwing a bright refracted caustic onto the grain beneath it; the tall blue spiked gear, green and orange gear cluster, and yellow plastic pieces sit softly out of focus at frame left, while the upright black domino blocks line frame right and the trough narrows into the blurred distance. Immediately the marble begins rolling away from the camera down the center of the channel, and the camera starts a smooth forward tracking follow that keeps <Subject1> in the lower center of the frame; the marble accelerates along the straight trough, its clear surface spinning so that the blue and yellow ribbon rotates continuously inside the glass, and the raised wooden rails slide past on both sides while the colorful gears at frame left and the black dominoes at frame right sweep by in soft parallax <a crisp, continuous glass-on-wood rolling sound that rises in pace as speed builds>. Around 3.5 seconds the trough curves gently to the right, the camera eases right with the bend while maintaining the same low tracking height, and the line of black domino blocks at frame right blurs past in rapid succession as the marble holds the center of the groove without touching the side rails; the background wooden supports and distant colored plastic pieces stretch into soft motion trails while the overhead spot bokeh drifts across the upper frame.

At 6.8 seconds, <the rolling hum continues, joined by a sharper rattle as the marble crosses a short jointed section>. The same continuous tracking shot follows <Subject1> as the trough straightens again and dips slightly, the marble lifting a fraction over a small rounded wooden ridge in the channel before settling back into the groove, its refracted caustic dancing across the wood grain; the colorful gear cluster at frame left recedes behind the foreground rail, and additional yellow and blue plastic components come into view along the right side of the track while the black domino line ends and gives way to more wooden support blocks. The camera keeps pace precisely with the marble, neither pulling ahead nor falling behind, so that <Subject1> remains the sharp focal point while the surrounding track structure blurs with motion; finally the trough begins a gentle leftward bend, the marble rides the curve with a faint tilt against the inner rail <a brief, higher-pitched glass contact tick>, and the shot holds on the marble still rolling rapidly down the lighted wooden channel as the track structure continues to recede into the bokeh-lit background.

# Style and Tone
An Eastern grotesque fantasy 2D thick-paint animated short film, rendered with bold brushstrokes and dynamic motion blur, carries a tense, uncanny, wildly dramatic atmosphere with a pervading sense of eerie spectacle.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: A male martial protagonist seen from a low rear angle, wearing loose black cropped trousers, off-white linen leg wrappings stained with faint red marks, and dark straw sandals with thick wooden soles; a pale tunic hem and a fluttering red ribbon hang at his waist, and his calves show muscular definition under the wrappings.
<Subject2>: A swordsman in a light blue loose robe, black cropped trousers, white leg wrappings, and cloth slippers, hair tied in a topknot, running away from the camera toward a lit doorway with a sheathed sword at his waist.
<Subject3>: Bystanders outside the shop: a masked vendor in a pale green robe with a red grinning mask standing beside a wooden stall, a woman in a red-and-white layered Han robe with her hair in a bun, and two women on the opposite side in green and red Han robes with elaborate updos, pale painted faces, red cheek marks, and closed smiling eyes; one holds a feather fan.
<Subject4>: A troupe of dancing women in flowing red, green, and white silk Han robes with long sleeves, hair in ornate updos decorated with pins and flowers, their faces painted pale with red lips and cheek marks, performing synchronized Eastern dance with swirling sleeves.
<Subject5>: A burly man with a broad build, wearing a dark open tunic that reveals his chest, leaning on a wooden railing to watch the performance and later lifting a brown wine gourd.
<Scene1>: A misty old-town street in front of a traditional Chinese shop at dusk, with cracked grey stone paving, a wooden stall under a tiled awning bearing a faded cloth sign, dark timber buildings with curved tiled eaves, red paper lanterns hanging from the eaves, and a brightly lit open shop entrance spilling warm yellow light through lattice doors; cool blue evening ambient mixes with warm lantern glow and doorway light, and dust hangs in the air near the ground.
<Scene2>: An open-air performance stage and viewing area beside the street, with a raised wooden stage, red drapes, hanging red lanterns, a rough wooden viewing railing, and packed earth ground lit by warm lantern light against cool blue night shadow.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
On a misty lantern-lit old street <Scene1>, the camera chases the running legs of the protagonist <Subject1> toward a shop as the bystanders <Subject3> dissolve into flowing red silk and flee, then a hard rightward whip pan reveals dancers <Subject4> performing on a stage <Scene2> while a burly spectator <Subject5> leans on the railing and lifts his wine gourd to watch.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, [a driving, percussive Eastern folk score with rapid drum patterns and piercing suona begins]. A low-angle rear close shot frames <Subject1> from the waist down at the center of <Scene1>, his right sandal thrust forward toward the camera with its thick grooved wooden sole filling the lower right foreground and his left sandal planted on the cracked stone paving behind, dust and small debris kicking up around the soles; beyond his straddled legs, <Subject2> runs away from the camera up the stone steps toward the brightly lit shop entrance, sword swinging at his hip, while <Subject3> line both sides of the doorway: the masked vendor stands at frame left beside the wooden stall with its faded cloth sign, the red-robed woman stands just left of the steps with hands folded, and the two painted women stand at frame right in green and red robes, one holding a feather fan, all smiling toward the entrance beneath hanging red lanterns and curved tiled eaves. The camera begins a fast low forward track directly behind <Subject1>'s legs, keeping the striding sandals in the lower foreground as they pound the stone in rapid alternating steps, dust plumes bursting outward with each impact and motion blur streaking the trouser hems, fluttering red waist ribbon, and trailing leg wrappings; as the stride closes distance to the doorway, the figures of <Subject3> begin to shimmer and unravel from the hems upward, their robes and sleeves dissolving into long streams of glossy red silk that coil and snap in the wind, their painted faces stretching into wide grins before the silk streams whip away from the steps and the stall, leaving only swirling red cloth and drifting dust where they stood <sharp fabric rustles and panicked, wordless cries fading into wind>; finally the forward rush carries <Subject1> almost to the stone steps, with the lit doorway glowing ahead and red silk still trailing across the paving.

At 4.2 seconds, [the driving Eastern folk score shifts into a swirling, dance-led passage with plucked strings and rapid flute trills]. A hard whip pan snaps the view rapidly to the right, the street, lanterns, and trailing red silk blurring into horizontal streaks of red, blue, and warm yellow before the motion settles on <Scene2>; the camera resolves into a fluid lateral tracking shot moving rightward along the rough wooden viewing railing, where <Subject5> leans forward with both forearms on the rail, broad shoulders filling the midground as he watches the raised wooden stage. On the stage, <Subject4> perform a synchronized Eastern dance in a tight formation, their long silk sleeves unfurling and sweeping through the air in broad arcs, bodies leaning and turning in exaggerated, fluid motions with hair ornaments and sashes trailing, motion blur smearing the red, green, and white fabric into continuous painterly strokes under the red lantern glow; the camera continues its smooth rightward glide, keeping the swirling dancers in the midground while <Subject5> straightens from the railing, reaches to his waist with one large hand, and lifts a rounded brown wine gourd to his mouth, tilting his head back to drink before lowering it again with a broad pleased smile, his other hand thumping the railing in time <liquid glugs from the gourd and the thud of a hand on wood over the continuing score>; finally the lateral move slows and holds on the stage composition, the dancers' sleeves still swirling in mid-arc and <Subject5> holding the gourd at his chest as the warm lantern light pools on the red drapes and cool blue night shadow fills the background.

# Style and Tone
A playful domestic pet cinematic live-action short video carries a lighthearted, cozy and comedic atmosphere with a pervading sense of mischief.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: Short-haired black domestic cat with glossy solid-black fur, pale yellow-green eyes, upright pointed ears, long black tail, and white whiskers; compact, alert build.
<Subject2>: Short-haired white domestic cat with dense pure-white fur, pale yellow-green eyes, pink inner ears and nose, long white whiskers, and a white tail; rounded, curious build.
<Subject3>: Open rectangular brown corrugated cardboard box standing upright on the floor, empty inside, with folded top flaps pressed outward, visible corrugated edges, and a matte kraft-brown exterior.
<Scene1>: Bright domestic living-room interior with warm honey-brown hardwood floorboards showing visible grain, a pale off-white back wall with a white baseboard, a light brown woven plant pot holding a broad-leaf green houseplant at the back left, a partial medium-brown wooden dresser with a dark round drawer knob at the far left, and soft beige and off-white draped curtains at the back right; soft natural daylight filters in from the right, casting gentle shadows across the wood floor.

# Overlays
No persistent subtitles, watermarks, on-screen text, UI elements, or overlays appear in the video.

# Summary
In a sunlit living room <Scene1>, a black cat <Subject1> and a white cat <Subject2> face each other across an upright cardboard box <Subject3>, peer over its rim, then leap into it together, tipping the box over and tumbling out onto the hardwood floor in a playful scuffle as the tracking camera follows the whole sequence.

# Complete Description
At 0.0 seconds, <soft indoor room tone with faint distant bird chirp outside the curtains>. A locked-off eye-level wide shot frames <Scene1> with <Subject3> centered on the hardwood floor, its open top facing upward and empty brown interior visible; <Subject1> sits upright on its haunches at frame left with both front paws resting on the left rim of the box, tail stretched straight out behind on the floor, head turned right to stare across the box at <Subject2>, while <Subject2> mirrors the pose at frame right with both white front paws hooked over the right rim, hind paws tucked beneath its body and tail laid out to the right, head turned left to meet <Subject1>'s gaze. Both cats hold still for a beat, ears forward and whiskers fanned, their eyes locked across the box width; then their hindquarters tense, tails twitch once, and the camera begins a smooth forward tracking move as both cats push off the floor with their back legs and launch upward over the rim in unison <light claw scrabbling on cardboard, two quick playful meows>. Their front paws clear the edge first, bodies arching over the open top, and they drop into the empty interior together, landing on the cardboard bottom with <soft thuds of paws on cardboard followed by a louder hollow thump> as the box rocks sharply backward under their combined weight.

At 2.8 seconds, <cardboard scraping across wood, continuing playful meows and paw friction>. The camera stays with the action in a continuous side-on tracking shot that lowers and follows the tipping motion. <Subject3> tilts forward onto its front face, the open top rotating toward the floor as the back edge lifts; inside the tipping box, <Subject1> and <Subject2> tumble against one another in a tangle of black and white fur, paws scrambling against the corrugated walls <rapid claw scrabbling inside cardboard>. The leading edge of the box hits the floor and skids a short distance forward with a <rough cardboard scrape on hardwood>, then the whole box falls onto its side facing the camera, its open mouth now pointing toward the lens, and both cats spill out over the lowered rim in a rolling tumble: <Subject1> emerges first at frame left, landing on its side with a <soft muffled thud on wood> before righting itself, while <Subject2> rolls out just after at frame right, white fur ruffled, also landing with a <soft thud> and immediately pushing up onto its paws. The camera pulls back slightly and keeps both cats in frame as they recover on the floor in front of the now-horizontal box, facing each other again with ears alert and tails flicking; <light paw-pad friction on the floor, short playful chirps between the two cats> continue as they settle into a low playful crouch on either side of the overturned <Subject3>, and finally the frame holds on the two cats facing each other across the fallen box with the warm daylight still falling across the wood floor.

cases.title: 口红环球长镜头
cases.prompt:
15秒高端口红广告大片，超写实CG，电影级运镜，连续长镜头，无缝全球穿越，世界地标逐步毛绒化，飞过后才发生转变，非瞬间变化，柔软粉色绒毛材质（参考图2），奢侈品广告质感，高级视觉特效，真实光影与体积云效果。

整个视频采用一个连续长镜头，一镜到底，无切镜，无场景重置，无蒙太奇拼接。镜头始终跟随同一支巨大的图1裸粉色唇膏飞行，仿佛进行一场跨越全球的梦幻旅程。图1唇膏造型在全片中保持完全一致。

开场是纽约时代广场。真实城市环境，摩天大楼、LED广告屏、人群与车流全部保持现实质感。镜头仰拍中央巨型广告屏，广告屏内部突然出现能量波动，一支巨大的图1裸粉色唇膏缓缓突破屏幕，从数字世界飞入现实世界屏幕碎片化为粒子光效消散，镜头迅速跟随图1唇膏向前飞行。（音频：低频能量涌动，屏幕破裂粒子声，唇膏破屏而出的 whoosh，城市环境底噪轻衬。）

图1唇膏在时代广场上空加速穿梭，尾部持续释放轻盈柔软的粉色绒毛云雾。注意，所有建筑和街道在图1唇膏经过之前都保持真实状态。当图1唇膏飞过后，粉色云雾才开始附着在建筑表面。玻璃幕墙逐渐长出柔软绒毛，墙体被粉色毛绒缓慢覆盖，街道和城市设施也逐渐变成蓬松的粉色材质。整个转变具有明显的时间差和因果关系，绝不是瞬间完成。（音频：疾速飞行破风声）

镜头持续向前推进，没有任何切换。纽约天际线出现在前方。图1唇膏从高楼之间高速穿过，镜头紧紧跟随。高楼最初保持真实玻璃与钢结构，当粉色尾迹掠过之后，绒毛从建筑表面逐渐扩散生长，纽约天际线一点点变成梦幻的粉色毛绒城市。

镜头继续向前飞行，自然穿越云层与海洋。远处出现自由女神像。自由女神最开始完全真实，青铜材质清晰可见。图1唇膏绕自由女神飞行一周，粉色云雾从火炬开始向下蔓延。随着镜头继续运动，雕像逐渐被柔软粉色绒毛包裹，最终变成巨大的毛绒雕塑。（音频：云层穿越的呼啸，海面风声铺底）

镜头没有停顿，图1续向前飞行。巴黎凯旋门逐渐出现在地平线。图1唇膏径直穿过凯旋门中央拱门。石材纹理最初保持真实状态。随着粉色尾迹经过，绒毛沿雕刻纹理生长蔓延，凯旋门缓慢变成柔软的粉色毛绒建筑。镜头直接穿过拱门继续向前

远处埃菲尔铁塔逐渐出现。镜头从塔底仰拍向上。图1唇膏围绕铁塔盘旋上升。钢铁结构保持真实状态，随后被粉色绒毛逐步覆盖。绒毛沿铁塔钢架节点不断扩散，最终整座埃菲尔铁塔变成梦幻的粉色毛绒地标

镜头继续前进穿越天空。富士山逐渐出现在云层之上。雪山最开始保持真实自然景观。图1唇膏掠过山体，粉色云雾沿山坡向上扩散。白雪逐渐变成柔软蓬松的粉色绒毛，森林也被梦幻粉色覆盖。整座富士山仿佛变成巨型毛绒玩具。


广告进入高潮。镜头跟随图1唇膏缓缓下降。最终降落在米兰大教堂外边的广场。落地瞬间，最后一圈粉色绒毛云雾向四周扩散。整个街区完成最终毛绒化。

镜头缓缓后拉并升空。俯瞰已经被改造完成的粉色毛绒城市。阳光穿过粉色云层，空气中漂浮轻柔绒毛颗粒。高级、梦幻、治愈、奢华的商业广告氛围。画面中央预留品牌Logo与广告字幕位置。

# Style and Tone
A hyper-realistic CG luxury lipstick commercial with cinematic one-take camera movement, seamless global travel, premium VFX, real lighting and volumetric clouds, delivering an opulent, dreamy, healing mood in 9:16 framing.

# Subject and Scene
<Subject1>: References the nude-pink lipstick in <Image1>. A giant nude-pink lipstick with a square matte nude-beige base engraved "LUMIÈRE BEAUTY", a polished rose-gold middle collar, and a smoothly sculpted warm nude-pink bullet extended upward, maintaining an identical shape throughout the flight and trailing soft pink fluffy cloud vapour behind it.
<Scene1>: References the soft pink fluffy material covering landmarks and clouds in <Image2>. A continuous global aerial journey beginning over real-world Times Square with realistic skyscrapers, LED billboards, crowds and traffic, then progressing through the New York skyline, open sky and ocean past the Statue of Liberty, onward to Paris with the Arc de Triomphe and Eiffel Tower, then above the clouds to Mount Fuji, and finally descending to the plaza outside Milan Cathedral; before the lipstick passes, all landmarks, streets, water and sky retain photoreal textures and lighting, and after it passes surfaces gradually grow soft pink fluffy material, culminating in a fully pink fluffy city under volumetric pink clouds with warm sunlight and floating fluff particles; overall lighting starts as bright natural daylight and evolves into warm golden sun glow with soft volumetric rays.

# Overlays
A clean central reserved area at frame centre in the final aerial shot for brand logo and ad copy, kept empty of text during flight until the end beat, where elegant luxury-brand typography is positioned to be added without obscuring the main subject.

In a dim night museum gallery, a young woman stands beside a spotlighted marble bust of David and calmly watches as a thin fluorescent green horizontal laser scans slowly from top to bottom, cleanly and seamlessly transforming the rough matte marble above the line into a smooth, slightly reflective glossy white material below it.

A single overhead spotlight pools cool light on <Subject2> (laser)'s initial position at the very top edge of the marble bust, leaving the surrounding gallery in deep shadow and the smooth light-grey floor barely lit. <Subject1> (woman) stands at frame right beside the bust, upright and composed, both feet planted, her right arm relaxed at her side, her left hand resting in her trousers pocket, her gaze directed toward the statue with a calm, professional expression. The entire bust reads as rough, matte white marble with soft sculptural shadows; the thin fluorescent green <Subject2> (laser) appears as a razor-thin horizontal line at the crown of the bust, glowing softly against the stone. <low ambient museum hum> [subtle low cinematic drone begins]

2.0–7.5 seconds, Camera holds the same locked wide shot without moving. <Subject2> (laser) travels slowly and steadily downward across the bust at a constant pace, its horizontal line remaining perfectly level and its green glow crisp. As the line passes over the sculpted hair, forehead, eyes, nose, cheeks, mouth, and chin, a clean, seamless material transition occurs exactly at the laser: the marble above the line stays rough, grainy, and matte white, while the marble immediately below the line transforms into a highly smooth, slightly reflective glossy white surface that catches the spotlight with gentle highlights. The transition boundary stays razor-sharp and physically continuous, with no flicker, gap, or double-image; the glossy section grows steadily downward as the matte section shrinks. <Subject1> (woman) remains at frame right, her head following the laser's descent subtly, her expression still calm and focused, her posture unchanged. <faint high-pitched laser scanning whine> [low cinematic drone continues, subtle tonal shift as glossy area expands]

7.5–10.0 seconds, Camera holds the same locked wide shot. <Subject2> (laser) completes its sweep across the bust's chest and base, reaching the bottom edge of the sculpture and then fading out cleanly, leaving no residual glow. The entire bust is now uniformly smooth, glossy white with soft, realistic reflections of the spotlight and faint ambient light, the former rough matte texture fully replaced without seams or artifacts. <Subject1> (woman) shifts her gaze slightly upward to take in the fully transformed bust, maintaining her composed professional stance at frame right. The spotlight remains steady, soft shadows settle under the bust's chin and shoulders, and the gallery's restrained, elegant atmosphere holds to the end. <laser whine fades out> [low cinematic drone resolves on a quiet sustained note]
